keys.zhMeaning: 指定 advisor 工具由哪个模型回答；未设置则关闭顾问。
keys.descEn: Pick which model answers when Claude asks the advisor tool
keys.meaningEn: Pick which model answers when Claude calls the server-side advisor tool. Unset it to turn the advisor off. The advisor must be at least as capable as your main model; when it isn't, Claude Code sends requests without the advisor. See Choose an advisor model.
keys.type: string, one of the aliases `"fable"`, `"opus"`, or `"sonnet"`, which resolve to Claude Code's current default version of that model family, or a full model ID such as `"claude-opus-5"`
keys.default: unset, so the advisor is off
keys.overrides: `--advisor` takes precedence over this key for one session. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL` turns the advisor off, and this key can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 让每次会话都以指定名称的子代理启动，沿用其提示、工具和模型。
keys.descEn: Start every session as a named subagent with its prompt, tools, and model
keys.meaningEn: Run the main thread as a named subagent, so Claude Code applies that subagent's system prompt, tool restrictions, and model to your session. The same key sets the default agent for sessions you dispatch from `claude agents`.
keys.type: string, the name of a built-in or custom agent
keys.default: unset, so the main thread runs as Claude Code's default agent
keys.overrides: `--agent` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 允许 Claude 在它判断需要时向手机发送推送通知。
keys.descEn: Let Claude send a push notification to your phone when it decides to
keys.meaningEn: Allow Claude to send a push notification to your phone when it decides one is worth sending, for example when a long task finishes. Claude Code syncs this choice to your account, and pushes arrive while Remote Control is connected. Appears in `/config` as **Push when Claude decides**.
typeValues: `true`: Claude can send a push notification to your phone when it decides one is worth sending
`false`: Claude doesn't send those notifications
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code also reads a value left in `~/.claude.json` by older versions.

keys.zhMeaning: 在已部署 managed-mcp.json 时，仍加载 claude.ai 连接器。
keys.descEn: Load claude.ai connectors alongside a deployed managed-mcp.json
keys.meaningEn: Load the claude.ai connectors Claude Code fetches itself alongside a deployed `managed-mcp.json`. Without this key, `managed-mcp.json` takes exclusive control of MCP servers and suppresses those connectors.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code loads the claude.ai connectors alongside a deployed `managed-mcp.json`
`false`: a deployed `managed-mcp.json` takes exclusive control of MCP servers and suppresses claude.ai connectors
keys.default: `false`, so a deployed `managed-mcp.json` suppresses claude.ai connectors
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Users can't re-enable connectors that exclusive control suppressed.

keys.zhMeaning: 替换默认可向频道推送消息的 channel plugin 允许列表。
keys.descEn: Replace the default allowlist of channel plugins that can push messages
keys.meaningEn: Choose which channel plugins can push messages into sessions in your organization. When you set it, Claude Code uses your list in place of the default Anthropic allowlist; each entry names a plugin and the marketplace it comes from.
keys.type: array of objects, each with `marketplace` and `plugin` strings
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the default Anthropic allowlist

keys.zhName: HTTP 钩子 URL 允许列表
keys.zhMeaning: 限制 HTTP hooks 可以请求的 URL。
keys.descEn: Limit which URLs HTTP hooks can target
keys.meaningEn: Limit which URLs HTTP hooks can target. When you define this key, Claude Code runs an HTTP hook only if its URL matches one of the patterns and blocks the rest without running them; an empty array blocks every HTTP hook.
keys.type: array of URL patterns, with `*` as a wildcard
keys.default: unset, so any URL is allowed
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Arrays merge across settings files.

keys.zhMeaning: 只允许名单中的 MCP 服务器被使用。
keys.descEn: Allowlist which MCP servers people can use
keys.meaningEn: Allowlist the MCP servers people can use. Claude Code blocks any server that doesn't match an entry, whichever settings file or `.mcp.json` defined it, including servers from `managed-mcp.json`. Built-in servers such as Claude in Chrome, IDE-provided servers, and servers the CLI itself configures are exempt from the allowlist; the denylist still applies to them.
keys.type: array of objects, each with exactly one key: `serverName`, a string limited to letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores; `serverCommand`, an array of the command and its arguments matched exactly; or `serverUrl`, a URL pattern with `*` wildcards
keys.default: unset, so every server is allowed; an empty array blocks every server
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Entries from every file merge into one allowlist unless `allowManagedMcpServersOnly` is set. Deploy it in managed settings to enforce it.

keys.zhMeaning: 只运行组织通过托管设置部署的 hooks。
keys.descEn: Run only the hooks your organization deploys
keys.meaningEn: Restrict hook execution to hooks your organization deploys.
typeValues: `true`: only managed hooks run, plus Agent SDK hooks and hooks from plugins your managed settings force-enable. See What runs under `allowManagedHooksOnly`
`false`: hooks from every settings file and plugin run
keys.default: unset, so hooks from every settings file and plugin run

keys.zhName: 仅托管 MCP 允许列表
keys.zhMeaning: 让托管 MCP 允许列表成为唯一生效的名单。
keys.descEn: Make the managed MCP allowlist the only one that applies
keys.meaningEn: Make the managed allowlist the only one that applies. Claude Code then reads `allowedMcpServers` from managed settings alone and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings; `deniedMcpServers` still merges from every file, so users can still block servers for themselves. Administrators set it so a user's own settings can't broaden what the managed allowlist permits.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code reads `allowedMcpServers` from managed settings alone and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings
`false`: allowlists from every settings file merge
keys.default: `false`, so allowlists from every settings file merge

keys.zhMeaning: 只接受托管设置里的权限规则，忽略其他文件。
keys.descEn: Make managed settings the only source of permission rules
keys.meaningEn: Make managed settings the only source of `allow`, `ask`, and `deny` permission rules. Claude Code then ignores rules in user, project, local, and `--settings` files, ignores `--allowedTools`, hides the always-allow choices in permission prompts, and stops saving new rules.
typeValues: `true`: managed settings are the only source of `allow`, `ask`, and `deny` rules; Claude Code ignores rules from other files and `--allowedTools`, hides always-allow choices, and stops saving new rules
`false`: Claude Code applies permission rules from user, project, local, and `--settings` files in addition to the managed ones
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code applies permission rules from user, project, and local settings and from `--settings`, in addition to the managed ones

keys.zhMeaning: 为所有会话关闭扩展思考；思考默认已开启，true 通常无额外效果。
keys.descEn: Turn extended thinking off for every session
keys.meaningEn: Turn extended thinking off for every session by setting this to `false`. Thinking is on by default, so `true` changes nothing. Most people set this through `/config` rather than by editing the file.
typeValues: `true`: no effect; thinking is already on
`false`: Claude Code turns extended thinking off for every session
keys.default: unset, so thinking is on for models that support it
keys.overrides: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` takes precedence over this key for one session: `0` turns thinking off, under the same model and provider limits as `false`, and a positive value turns thinking on even when this key is `false`. On adaptive-reasoning models the number itself is ignored
keys.numeric: 相关环境变量 MAX_THINKING_TOKENS：官方写明 0 表示关闭思考；正值即使本键为 false 也会打开思考。自适应推理模型会忽略该数字本身。

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令生成 API 凭证。不要把密钥写进配置文件。
keys.descEn: Generate the API credential with your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command to produce the credential Claude Code sends with model requests. Claude Code runs the command through the system shell, `/bin/sh` on macOS and Linux and `cmd` on Windows, and sends its output as both the `X-Api-Key` and `Authorization: Bearer` headers. Use it for dynamic or rotating credentials, such as short-lived tokens fetched from a vault.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't run a helper

keys.zhMeaning: 无人回答的问题在空闲一段时间后自动继续。
keys.descEn: Let an unanswered question auto-continue after idle time
keys.meaningEn: Let an unanswered `AskUserQuestion` dialog auto-continue after a period of idle time, submitting whatever options you had already selected. Set it when you step away and want Claude to continue without you. With the default, questions wait until you answer them. Requires Claude Code v2.1.200 or later.
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS` takes precedence over this key for one session
keys.numeric: 官方枚举是 "60s"、"5m"、"10m" 或 "never"，不是原始毫秒数。默认 "never"。

keys.zhMeaning: 自定义 Claude Code 写进提交和 PR 的署名。
keys.descEn: Customize the attribution Claude Code adds to commits and pull requests
keys.meaningEn: Customize the attribution Claude Code adds to git commits and pull requests. Commits get a git trailer such as `Co-Authored-By` by default; pull request descriptions get plain text. Set each part separately with the sub-keys below.
keys.type: object with `commit` and `pr` strings and a `sessionUrl` Boolean
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the standard attribution shown under each sub-key

keys.zhMeaning: 更改或隐藏提交里的 trailer 署名。
keys.descEn: Change or hide the trailer Claude Code adds to commits
keys.meaningEn: Set the attribution text Claude Code adds to git commits, including any trailers. Set it to an empty string to hide commit attribution.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code adds `Co-Authored-By: <model name> <noreply@anthropic.com>`, where the model name reflects the active model for the session, such as `Claude Sonnet 5`, or `Claude` alone when the session's model isn't a public model

keys.zhMeaning: 更改或隐藏拉取请求描述里的署名行。
keys.descEn: Change or hide the attribution line in pull request descriptions
keys.meaningEn: Set the attribution text Claude Code adds to pull request descriptions. Set it to an empty string to hide pull request attribution.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code adds `🤖 Generated with Claude Code`

keys.zhMeaning: 从云端或 Remote Control 提交中省略 claude.ai 会话链接。
keys.descEn: Omit the claude.ai session link from cloud and Remote Control commits
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether Claude Code appends the claude.ai session link when it commits or opens a pull request from a cloud or Remote Control session. Claude Code adds the link as a `Claude-Session` trailer on commits and as a link in pull request descriptions. Set it to `false` to omit the link.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code appends the claude.ai session link when it commits or opens a pull request from a cloud or Remote Control session
`false`: Claude Code omits the link

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭上下文自动压缩。
keys.descEn: Turn automatic compaction off or on
keys.meaningEn: Have Claude Code compact the conversation automatically when context approaches the limit. Appears in `/config` as **Auto-compact**, and toggling it there writes this key to your user settings.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code compacts the conversation automatically when context approaches the limit
`false`: Claude Code doesn't compact automatically
keys.overrides: `DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` turns auto-compact off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 设置上下文填充到多少 token 时触发自动压缩。
keys.descEn: Set how full the context gets before Claude Code compacts
keys.meaningEn: Set how full the context window gets before Claude Code compacts automatically.
keys.type: number of tokens, from `100000` to `1000000`. Claude Code caps the value at your model's context window; the models overview lists each model's window
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code picks a window tuned for your model
keys.overrides: `--autocompact` takes precedence over this key for one session, and `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` takes precedence over both
keys.numeric: 官方：token 数量，范围 100000 到 1000000；会再封顶到当前模型上下文窗口。默认未设置，由 Claude Code 按模型选择。

keys.zhMeaning: 从外部终端启动时自动连接已在运行的 VS Code 或 JetBrains。
keys.descEn: Connect to a running VS Code or JetBrains IDE automatically from an external terminal
keys.meaningEn: Connect to a running IDE automatically when you start Claude Code from an external terminal. Appears in `/config` as **Auto-connect to IDE (external terminal)** when you run Claude Code outside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code connects to a running IDE automatically when you start it from an external terminal
`false`: Claude Code doesn't connect automatically from an external terminal; inside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal, or with `--ide`, it still connects
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE` takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction

keys.zhMeaning: 遇到 claude.ai 用量上限时在当前会话等待，重置后自动继续任务。
keys.descEn: Wait in the open session and continue the task automatically after a claude.ai usage limit resets
keys.meaningEn: After a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, wait in the open session and continue the task automatically after the reset. See Turn automatic continue off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.234 or later.
typeValues: `true`: after a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, Claude Code waits in the open session and continues the task automatically after the reset
`false`: Claude Code doesn't start the wait on its own. You can still start a wait yourself from the usage-limit options menu
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. Read from user settings, `--settings`, and managed settings only. When none of those sets the key, a project or local settings file that sets it turns the feature off rather than being ignored.

keys.zhName: 自动安装 IDE 扩展
keys.zhMeaning: 从 VS Code 终端运行时自动安装 IDE 扩展。
keys.descEn: Turn off automatic install of the IDE extension from a VS Code terminal
keys.meaningEn: Install the Claude Code IDE extension automatically when you run Claude Code from a VS Code terminal. Appears in `/config` as **Auto-install IDE extension** when you run Claude Code inside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code installs the IDE extension automatically when you run it from a VS Code terminal
`false`: Claude Code doesn't install the extension automatically
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL` set to `1` skips the install for one session even when this key is `true`

keys.zhMeaning: 把 auto memory 存到你指定的目录。
keys.descEn: Store auto memory in a directory you choose
keys.meaningEn: Store auto memory in a directory of your choice instead of the per-project default.
keys.type: string, an absolute or `~/`-prefixed directory path

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭 auto memory。
keys.descEn: Turn auto memory off or on
keys.meaningEn: Turn auto memory on or off. When `false`, Claude doesn't read from or write to the auto memory directory. You can also toggle it with `/memory` during a session, which writes this key to your user settings.
typeValues: `true`: the same as unset; auto memory stays on unless something that outranks this key turns it off for the session, such as `--bare`, safe mode, or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY`
`false`: Claude doesn't read from or write to the auto memory directory
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY` takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction

keys.zhMeaning: 为 auto mode 分类器追加你自己的 allow / deny 规则。
keys.descEn: Add your own allow and deny rules to the auto mode classifier
keys.meaningEn: Add your own rules to what the auto mode classifier blocks and allows. Use it to tell the classifier which repos, buckets, and domains your organization trusts, so it stops blocking routine internal operations. The classifier ships with built-in allow and deny rules. Include the literal string `"$defaults"` in an array to keep those built-in rules at that position and add yours around them; leave it out to replace them with yours.
keys.type: object with `environment`, `allow`, `soft_deny`, and `hard_deny` arrays of prose rules, plus the `classifyAllShell` Boolean
keys.default: unset, so the classifier uses only its built-in rules

keys.zhName: 自动模式分类全部 Shell
keys.zhMeaning: 让每条 shell 命令都经过 auto mode 分类器，即使已被窄 allow 规则匹配。
keys.descEn: Send every shell command through the auto mode classifier, even ones a narrow allow rule matches
keys.meaningEn: Send every Bash and PowerShell command through the auto mode classifier while auto mode is active. By default, auto mode suspends only allow rules that could run arbitrary code: tool-wide and wildcard rules such as `Bash(*)`, and interpreter or shell-wrapper prefixes such as `Bash(python *)`. A command that any other allow rule matches, such as `Bash(npm test)`, skips the classifier, and a destructive argument the rule's prefix didn't anticipate can get through unseen. Setting this key suspends every shell allow rule for the session so the classifier sees every command. Requires Claude Code v2.1.193 or later.
typeValues: `true`: while auto mode is active, Claude Code sends every Bash and PowerShell command through the classifier and suspends your shell allow rules; outside auto mode the rules still apply

`false`: auto mode suspends only allow rules that could run arbitrary code, such as `Bash(*)` and `Bash(python *)`; a command that any other allow rule matches skips the classifier, and every other shell command goes through it
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. Read wherever `autoMode` is read.

keys.zhMeaning: 全屏渲染时跟随新输出滚到最底部。
keys.descEn: Follow new output to the bottom in fullscreen rendering
keys.meaningEn: Follow new output to the bottom of the conversation in fullscreen rendering. Turn it off to stay where you scrolled while Claude keeps working; permission prompts still scroll into view.
typeValues: `true`: the conversation follows new output to the bottom
`false`: you stay where you scrolled while Claude keeps working; permission prompts still appear below the transcript

keys.zhMeaning: 跟随 stable 发布通道，而不是 latest。
keys.descEn: Follow the stable release channel instead of latest
keys.meaningEn: Choose which release channel background auto-updates and `claude update` follow. Set `"stable"` for a version that is typically about one week old and skips releases with major regressions, or `"latest"` for the most recent release.
typeValues: `"latest"`: updates follow the most recent release
`"stable"`: updates follow a version that is typically about one week old and skips releases with major regressions
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Set it in managed settings to enforce one channel across your organization.

keys.zhMeaning: 限制人们可以挑选的模型。
keys.descEn: Restrict which models people can pick
keys.meaningEn: Restrict which models people can select for the main session, subagents, skills, and the advisor. A managed list constrains `/model`, `--model`, and the `model` key in a developer's own files; a model outside it can't be selected. On its own this doesn't touch the Default option; pair it with `enforceAvailableModels` for that.
keys.type: array of model aliases or IDs
keys.default: unset, so every model is available
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Deploy it in managed settings to enforce it for an organization.

keys.zhMeaning: 回到终端时显示或关闭会话回顾。
keys.descEn: Turn off the session recap shown when you come back to the terminal
keys.meaningEn: Show a one-line session recap when you return to the terminal after a few minutes away. Set it to `false`, or turn off **Session recap** in `/config`, to stop the recap.
typeValues: `true`: you see a one-line session recap when you return after a few minutes away
`false`: Claude Code shows no recap
keys.default: unset, so the recap is on
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY` takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令刷新过期的 Bedrock / .aws 凭证。
keys.descEn: Refresh expired Bedrock credentials in .aws with your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command, such as `aws sso login`, to refresh the credentials in your `.aws` directory when the ones Claude Code has for Amazon Bedrock stop working. Claude Code checks the current credentials against STS first and runs the command only when that check fails, then reads the refreshed `.aws` directory.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't refresh AWS credentials for you

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令以 JSON 提供 Bedrock 凭证。
keys.descEn: Supply Bedrock credentials as JSON from your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command that prints AWS credentials as JSON, so Claude Code can call Amazon Bedrock with credentials that don't live in your `.aws` directory. Claude Code accepts the `aws sts` output shape and the flat `aws configure export-credentials` shape, and scopes the credentials to its own Bedrock client, so the shell commands Claude runs still see your ambient credentials.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the ambient AWS credential chain

keys.zhMeaning: 输出更适合屏幕阅读器的内容。
keys.descEn: Render screen-reader friendly output
keys.meaningEn: Render screen-reader friendly output: flat text without decorative borders or animations. Screen-reader mode uses the classic renderer, so the `tui` setting has no effect while it is active; attached background sessions still render fullscreen. Requires Claude Code v2.1.181 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code renders flat text without decorative borders or animations, using the classic renderer
`false`: Claude Code renders normally
keys.default: unset, so screen-reader mode is off
keys.overrides: `--ax-screen-reader` takes precedence over `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER`, and both take precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 为企业屏蔽指定的插件市场来源。
keys.descEn: Block plugin marketplace sources for your organization
keys.meaningEn: Block plugin marketplace sources for your organization. Claude Code checks the blocklist on marketplace add and on plugin install, update, refresh, and auto-update, so a marketplace someone added before you set the policy can't be used to fetch plugins either. Blocked sources are checked before download, so they never touch the filesystem.
keys.type: array of marketplace source objects, in the same forms as `strictKnownMarketplaces`
keys.default: unset, so no marketplace is blocked

keys.zhMeaning: 禁止 Claude 在桌面 Browser 窗格的外部页面上使用工具。
keys.descEn: Keep Claude's tools off external pages in the desktop Browser pane
keys.meaningEn: Stop Claude from using its tools to read or act on external pages in the desktop app's Browser pane. People in your organization can still open external sites themselves, and local dev server previews keep working with Claude's tools. The desktop app reads this key; the terminal CLI ignores it.
keys.type: string, `"disabled"`; the desktop app also accepts `"disable"`, in either case
keys.default: unset, so Claude's tools work on external pages

keys.zhMeaning: 允许组织使用 channels。
keys.descEn: Allow channels for your organization
keys.meaningEn: Allow channels for your organization. On claude.ai Team and Enterprise plans, Claude Code blocks channels until you set this to `true`. For Anthropic Console accounts that authenticate with an API key, channels are allowed by default. If your organization deploys managed settings, Claude Code blocks channels on those accounts too until you set this key to `true`.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code allows channels for your organization
`false`: the same as unset; whether channels are blocked depends on your plan, as the Default says
keys.default: unset; channels are blocked on Team and Enterprise plans and on Console accounts with managed settings, and allowed on Pro and Max plans and on Console accounts without managed settings

keys.zhMeaning: 从托管设置注入全组织的 CLAUDE.md 说明。
keys.descEn: Inject organization-wide CLAUDE.md instructions from managed settings
keys.meaningEn: Inject CLAUDE.md-style instructions as organization-managed memory without deploying a separate file. Claude Code loads the text as a managed memory entry ahead of user and project CLAUDE.md files.
keys.type: string, the text of a CLAUDE.md file; write it as you would the file, Markdown included, with line breaks as `\n`

keys.zhMeaning: 加载记忆时跳过指定的 CLAUDE.md 文件。
keys.descEn: Skip specific CLAUDE.md files when memory loads
keys.meaningEn: Skip specific `CLAUDE.md` files when Claude Code loads memory. In a large monorepo, use it to skip CLAUDE.md files from other teams that aren't relevant to your work; Exclude irrelevant CLAUDE.md files in the large-codebases guide walks through that case. Patterns match against absolute file paths.
keys.type: array of strings, each a glob pattern or absolute path
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code loads every CLAUDE.md it finds

keys.zhMeaning: 设置转录和其他应用数据保留多少天后删除。
keys.descEn: Choose how many days Claude Code keeps transcripts before deleting them
keys.meaningEn: Set how many days Claude Code keeps session transcripts and other application data before deleting them. Claude Code runs the deletion as a background sweep after a session starts, as long as it can safely determine the retention period.
keys.type: number of days, a whole number, minimum `1`
keys.numeric: 官方：天为单位的整数，最小 1，默认 30。设为 0 无法通过校验；长期保留可用如 3650。

keys.zhMeaning: 启动时显示组织公告。
keys.descEn: Show your organization's announcements at startup
keys.meaningEn: Show your organization's announcements to users at startup. When you list more than one, Claude Code picks one at random for each session; on a person's very first launch it shows the first entry.

keys.zhMeaning: 选择接收、仅提示或拒绝来自其他会话的消息。
keys.descEn: Choose whether Claude Code delivers messages from your other sessions, shows a notice without delivering them, or refuses them
keys.meaningEn: Choose what this session does with messages arriving from your other Claude Code sessions. When no value applies, Claude Code decides per message from the two sessions' permission-mode classes. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.
typeValues: `"accept"`: Claude Code delivers the message to Claude
`"hold"`: Claude Code shows a notice for the message without delivering it
`"refuse"`: Claude Code drops the message
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code decides per message
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A project or local value applies only when it's stricter than the value managed settings, the `--settings` flag, or user settings give.

keys.zhMeaning: 决定用 ! 前缀输入的命令由 Bash 还是 PowerShell 执行。
keys.descEn: Choose whether Bash or PowerShell runs the shell commands you type with the ! prefix
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether Bash or PowerShell runs the shell commands you type with the `!` prefix in the input box, the ones Claude Code runs directly and adds to the session.
typeValues: `"bash"`: Claude Code runs your `!` commands in Bash
`"powershell"`: Claude Code runs your `!` commands in PowerShell
keys.default: `"bash"`, or `"powershell"` on Windows when Bash isn't available

keys.zhName: 拒绝的 MCP 服务器
keys.zhMeaning: 在所有范围屏蔽指定 MCP 服务器。
keys.descEn: Block specific MCP servers in every scope
keys.meaningEn: Block specific MCP servers. Claude Code refuses to load a matching server in every scope, including servers from `managed-mcp.json` and claude.ai connectors.
keys.type: array of objects, each with exactly one key: `serverName`, any non-empty string, so a claude.ai connector's display name such as `"claude.ai Slack"` works; `serverCommand`, an array of the command and its arguments matched exactly; or `serverUrl`, a URL pattern with `*` wildcards
keys.default: unset, so no server is blocked; an empty array also blocks nothing
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Entries from every file merge into one denylist, and `allowManagedMcpServersOnly` doesn't change that. Deploy it in managed settings to enforce it.

keys.zhMeaning: Remote Control 或 SDK 主机未应答转发对话框时，等待多久后取消。
keys.descEn: Set how long Claude Code waits for Remote Control or an SDK host to answer a forwarded dialog before it cancels the dialog
keys.meaningEn: Set the deadline for dialogs Claude Code forwards to a remote client, such as a Remote Control or SDK host, for the approval dialog for a held cross-session message, and for the mid-session Fable 5 usage-credits consent prompt in a session that may have nobody at the terminal. When no answer arrives before the deadline, Claude Code cancels the dialog and continues with its no-action default. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.
keys.type: string, one of `"60s"`, `"5m"`, `"10m"`, or `"never"`, which disables the deadline
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS` takes precedence over this key for one session
keys.numeric: 官方枚举是 "60s"、"5m"、"10m" 或 "never"（关闭截止）。默认 "5m"。

keys.zhMeaning: 选择把提议的文件改动显示在 IDE diff 还是终端。
keys.descEn: Choose whether Claude's proposed file changes open in the VS Code or JetBrains diff viewer or stay in the terminal
keys.meaningEn: Choose where Claude Code shows the diff of an `Edit` or `Write` change it proposes when a VS Code or JetBrains IDE is connected: `"auto"` opens it in the IDE's diff viewer, `"terminal"` keeps it in the terminal. Appears in `/config` as **Diff tool** only while Claude Code is connected to a VS Code or JetBrains IDE.
typeValues: `"auto"`: Claude Code opens the diff in the IDE's diff viewer when a VS Code or JetBrains IDE is connected
`"terminal"`: Claude Code keeps the diff in the terminal

keys.zhMeaning: 关闭后台代理和 agent view。
keys.descEn: Turn off background agents and agent view
keys.meaningEn: Turn off background agents and agent view: `claude agents`, `--bg`, `/background`, and the on-demand supervisor. Set it in managed settings to enforce it for an organization.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns off `claude agents`, `--bg`, `/background`, and the on-demand supervisor
`false`: agent view is available
keys.default: unset, so agent view is available
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW` turns agent view off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 一次关闭 hooks、自定义状态栏和自定义 @ 文件建议命令。
keys.descEn: Turn off hooks, a custom status line, and a custom @ file suggestion command at once
keys.meaningEn: Turn off hooks, any custom status line, and any custom file suggestion command. Use it to turn all of these off temporarily without deleting them from your settings.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns off hooks, any custom status line, and any custom file suggestion command
`false`: hooks, the status line, and the file suggestion command run
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Only managed settings can disable managed hooks.

keys.zhMeaning: 为所有人关闭 Artifact 工具；个人开关请用 enableArtifact。
keys.descEn: Turn the Artifact tool off for everyone; use enableArtifact for yourself
keys.meaningEn: Turn off the Artifact tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai, for everyone your settings reach, such as an organization through managed settings. To turn the tool off just for yourself, use `enableArtifact` instead, which the **Artifacts** toggle in `/config` writes to your user settings.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns off the Artifact tool for everyone your settings reach
`false`: the Artifact tool follows `enableArtifact` and your account's availability
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT` set to `1` turns the tool off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 从权限模式循环中移除 auto mode。
keys.descEn: Remove auto mode from the permission mode cycle
keys.meaningEn: Remove auto mode from the `Shift+Tab` cycle. Any session that would otherwise start in auto mode, whether from `--permission-mode auto`, a settings file, or the built-in default, starts in `default` instead. Administrators set it in managed settings to prevent developers in their organization from using auto mode.
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Most useful in managed settings, where users can't override it. Also accepted under `permissions` as `permissions.disableAutoMode`.

keys.zhMeaning: 把桌面 Browser 窗格限制在 localhost。
keys.descEn: Limit the desktop Browser pane to localhost for people and Claude
keys.meaningEn: Turn off external browsing in the desktop app's Browser pane for people and Claude alike. Localhost dev server previews keep working. The desktop app reads this key; the terminal CLI ignores it.
keys.type: Boolean; only the JSON Boolean `true` takes effect
typeValues: `true`: the desktop app turns off external browsing in the Browser pane for people and Claude alike; localhost previews keep working
`false`: external browsing stays on
keys.default: unset, so external browsing is on

keys.zhMeaning: 关闭随 Claude Code 附带的 skills 和 workflows。
keys.descEn: Turn off the skills and workflows included with Claude Code
keys.meaningEn: Turn off the skills and workflows included with Claude Code. Claude Code removes bundled skills and workflows entirely, while built-in commands such as `/init` stay typable but are hidden from the model.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code removes bundled skills and workflows and hides built-in commands such as `/init` from the model
`false`: bundled skills load
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS` set to `1` turns bundled skills off for one session; whichever of the two turns them off, the other can't turn them back on

keys.zhMeaning: 不让 Claude Code 拉取 claude.ai connectors。
keys.descEn: Turn off claude.ai connectors so Claude Code doesn't fetch them
keys.meaningEn: Turn off claude.ai MCP connectors so Claude Code neither fetches nor connects them. A `true` in any settings file applies: a checked-in project `.claude/settings.json` can opt a repository out of cloud connectors, but a project-level `false` can't override a user- or managed-level `true`. Requires Claude Code v2.1.182 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code neither fetches nor connects claude.ai MCP connectors
`false`: the same as unset; Claude Code fetches your connectors unless another settings file or `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS` turns them off
keys.default: `false`, so Claude Code fetches your connectors
keys.overrides: `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS` set to `false` turns connectors off for one session; whichever of the two turns them off, the other can't turn them back on

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止通过市场声明命令来安装的插件。
keys.descEn: Block plugins that install by running a marketplace-declared command
keys.meaningEn: Block the `command` plugin source, which installs a plugin by running a marketplace-declared command on the user's machine. When you set it to `true`, Claude Code never runs the command, doesn't install or update command-sourced plugins, and stops loading the ones already installed. Set it to `false` to allow them explicitly. Whenever it blocks command sources, whether you set it to `true` or leave it unset under `allowManagedHooksOnly`, it also blocks marketplace `headersHelper` commands, except for a marketplace that managed settings themselves declare. Requires Claude Code v2.1.229 or later, and the `headersHelper` block requires v2.1.238 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code never runs the marketplace-declared command, doesn't install or update command-sourced plugins, and stops loading the ones already installed
`false`: Claude Code allows command-sourced plugins explicitly
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code follows `allowManagedHooksOnly`: an organization that restricts hook execution to managed settings gets command sources disabled too

keys.zhMeaning: 停止注册 claude-cli:// 处理器。
keys.descEn: Stop Claude Code from registering the claude-cli:// handler
keys.meaningEn: Stop Claude Code from registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler with the operating system, which it otherwise does after you send the first prompt of an interactive session. Deep links let external tools open a Claude Code session with a pre-filled prompt. Set this in environments where protocol handler registration is restricted or managed separately.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code registers the handler

keys.zhMeaning: 关闭在本机运行的 Desktop Code 会话，只保留 SSH 与云端。
keys.descEn: Turn off Desktop Code sessions that run on the device, leaving SSH to other hosts and cloud
keys.meaningEn: Turn off Code sessions that run on the device in the desktop app, for deployments where developers should work on remote machines over SSH. In the Code tab, the **Local** environment stays in the environment dropdown but is grayed out and can't be selected, with a tooltip saying your organization turned it off; on Windows the WSL entry is grayed out the same way, though whether WSL sessions run on a managed device at all is governed separately. New sessions default to the first SSH connection if one is configured, and the app refuses to start or resume a session on the device, including an SSH connection back to the same machine. SSH sessions to other hosts and cloud sessions are unaffected. The desktop app reads this key; the terminal CLI ignores it.
keys.type: Boolean; only the JSON Boolean `true` takes effect
typeValues: `true`: the desktop app offers no on-device Code sessions; existing local sessions stay listed but can't continue
`false`: local sessions stay available
keys.default: unset, so local sessions are available

keys.zhMeaning: 拒绝项目 .mcp.json 中的指定服务器。
keys.descEn: Reject specific servers from a project's .mcp.json
keys.meaningEn: Reject specific servers defined in a project's `.mcp.json` file so Claude Code never connects them or asks you to approve them. A rejection in any settings file applies, including a project `.claude/settings.json` checked into the repository.
keys.type: array of strings, the server names as they appear in `.mcp.json`

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止 Claude 使用桌面 iOS Simulator 窗格中的工具。
keys.descEn: Block Claude's tools in the desktop iOS Simulator pane
keys.meaningEn: Block Claude's tools for the desktop app's iOS Simulator pane. People keep manual use of the pane; only Claude's access is removed, and nobody can turn it back on from inside the app. The desktop app reads this key; the terminal CLI ignores it.
keys.type: Boolean; only the JSON Boolean `true` takes effect
typeValues: `true`: the desktop app blocks Claude's tools for the iOS Simulator pane
`false`: Claude's simulator tools follow each person's settings toggle in the desktop app
keys.default: unset, so Claude's simulator tools follow each person's settings toggle in the desktop app

keys.zhMeaning: 在所有可启动处关闭 Remote Control。
keys.descEn: Turn off Remote Control everywhere it can start
keys.meaningEn: Turn off Remote Control: Claude Code then refuses `claude remote-control`, the `--remote-control` flag, auto-start, and the in-session toggle, and reports that your organization's policy disabled it. Place it in managed settings for per-device MDM enforcement.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code refuses `claude remote-control`, the `--remote-control` flag, auto-start, and the in-session toggle
`false`: Remote Control stays available

keys.zhMeaning: 拒绝用于旁加载插件、子代理和 MCP 服务器的 CLI 标志。
keys.descEn: Reject the CLI flags that sideload plugins, subagents, and MCP servers
keys.meaningEn: Reject the `--plugin-dir`, `--plugin-url`, `--agents`, and `--mcp-config` CLI flags at startup, which users could otherwise pass to bypass `strictKnownMarketplaces` for a single run. Claude Code exits with an error naming the rejected flags, and applies the same check to surfaces that start the CLI with these flags internally, currently Cowork local sessions in the desktop app. In cloud sessions, Claude Code drops the MCP servers the server delivered through `--mcp-config`, other than in-process `type: "sdk"` entries, and starts the session. Requires Claude Code v2.1.193 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code rejects `--plugin-dir`, `--plugin-url`, `--agents`, and `--mcp-config` at startup and exits with an error naming them, except that in cloud sessions it drops the MCP servers the server delivered through `--mcp-config`, other than in-process `type: "sdk"` entries, and starts the session
`false`: Claude Code accepts those flags

keys.zhMeaning: 禁止 skills 和自定义命令运行内联 shell。
keys.descEn: Stop skills and custom commands from running inline shell
keys.meaningEn: Turn off inline shell execution for `` !`...` `` and ` ```! ` blocks in skills and custom commands from user, project, plugin, or additional-directory sources. Claude Code replaces each command with `[shell command execution disabled by policy]` instead of running it.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code replaces each inline shell command with `[shell command execution disabled by policy]` instead of running it
`false`: inline shell runs
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A `true` in managed settings can't be overridden by `false` elsewhere.

keys.zhMeaning: 为所有人关闭动态 workflows；个人开关请用 enableWorkflows。
keys.descEn: Turn dynamic workflows off for everyone; use enableWorkflows for yourself
keys.meaningEn: Turn off dynamic workflows and the bundled workflow commands for everyone your settings reach, such as an organization through managed settings. To turn workflows on or off just for yourself, use `enableWorkflows` instead, which the **Dynamic workflows** toggle in `/config` writes to your user settings.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns off dynamic workflows and the bundled workflow commands for everyone your settings reach
`false`: the same as unset; whether workflows are on then follows `enableWorkflows` and your plan's default
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS` turns workflows off for one session; whichever of the two turns them off, the other can't turn them back on

keys.zhMeaning: 在输入框使用 vim 键绑定。
keys.descEn: Use vim key bindings in the input prompt
keys.meaningEn: Choose the key binding mode for the input prompt.
typeValues: `"normal"`: standard key bindings in the prompt input
`"vim"`: vim-style editing with NORMAL, INSERT, and VISUAL modes

keys.zhMeaning: 保存 /effort 级别，让后续会话推理更深或更浅。
keys.descEn: Save the /effort level so future sessions reason more or less deeply
keys.meaningEn: Keep an effort level across sessions. Lower levels are faster and cheaper on straightforward tasks, and higher levels reason more deeply on complex problems. Claude Code writes this key to your user settings when you run `/effort low`, `medium`, `high`, or `xhigh` in an interactive session on your machine. In a `-p` run, the Agent SDK, or a session attached to a remote worker, `/effort` applies to that session only. The message `/effort` prints says which happened.
typeValues: `"low"`: the least reasoning, for short, scoped, latency-sensitive tasks that aren't intelligence-sensitive
`"medium"`: reduces token usage for cost-sensitive work that can trade off some intelligence
`"high"`: balances token usage and intelligence
`"xhigh"`: deeper reasoning at higher token spend
keys.overrides: `--effort` takes precedence over this key for one session, and `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` takes precedence over both

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭输入框的 :shortcode: emoji 建议与替换。
keys.descEn: Turn off :shortcode: emoji suggestions and replacement in the prompt input
keys.meaningEn: Show emoji suggestions when you type `:` plus a shortcode in the prompt input, and replace a completed shortcode such as `:heart:` with its emoji. Set it to `false` to turn off both.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code shows emoji suggestions after `:` and replaces a completed shortcode with its emoji
`false`: Claude Code neither suggests emoji nor replaces shortcodes

keys.zhMeaning: 不经提示即批准项目 .mcp.json 中的所有服务器。
keys.descEn: Approve every server in project .mcp.json files without a prompt
keys.meaningEn: Approve every MCP server defined in project `.mcp.json` files without a prompt. Claude Code writes this key to `.claude/settings.local.json` when you choose to approve all servers in the approval dialog.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code approves every MCP server defined in project `.mcp.json` files without a prompt

`false`: Claude Code asks you to approve each server. In a trusted folder, a `false` in a higher-precedence file overrides a `true` in a lower one; in a folder you haven't trusted, a `true` in any honored file is enough
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code asks you to approve each server
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. In a folder whose trust dialog you haven't accepted, Claude Code honors it from user settings, managed settings, and `--settings` and ignores it in the shared project file, both in the session and for `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get`; Project server approvals and workspace trust says when an untracked `.claude/settings.local.json` counts too.

keys.zhMeaning: 为自己打开或关闭 Artifact 工具。
keys.descEn: Turn the Artifact tool on or off for yourself
keys.meaningEn: Turn the Artifact tool on or off for yourself. When unset, the default follows the feature's availability for your account. The **Artifacts** row in `/config` writes this key, so you don't usually edit it by hand. To turn artifacts off for everyone from managed settings, use `disableArtifact` instead. Requires Claude Code v2.1.196 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns the Artifact tool on for you where it's available for your account
`false`: Claude Code turns the Artifact tool off for you
keys.default: unset, so the tool follows your account's availability
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. Claude Code ignores the key in project and local settings so that a repository you clone can't turn the tool on for you.

keys.zhMeaning: 批准项目 .mcp.json 中的指定服务器。
keys.descEn: Approve specific servers from a project's .mcp.json
keys.meaningEn: Approve specific servers defined in project `.mcp.json` files so Claude Code connects them without asking. Claude Code writes this key to `.claude/settings.local.json` when you approve a server in the approval dialog.
keys.type: array of strings, the server names as they appear in `.mcp.json`
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. In a folder whose trust dialog you haven't accepted, Claude Code honors it from user settings, managed settings, and `--settings` and ignores it in the shared project file, both in the session and for `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get`; Project server approvals and workspace trust says when an untracked `.claude/settings.local.json` counts too.

keys.zhMeaning: 按范围打开或关闭单个插件。
keys.descEn: Turn individual plugins on or off per scope
keys.meaningEn: Turn individual plugins on or off, keyed by `plugin-name@marketplace-name`. A plugin with no entry at any scope falls back to its `defaultEnabled` value. When you enable or disable a plugin with `/plugin` or `claude plugin enable`, Claude Code writes this key for you.
keys.default: unset, so each plugin follows its `defaultEnabled` value

keys.zhMeaning: 按套餐默认值打开或关闭动态 workflows。
keys.descEn: Turn dynamic workflows on or off against your plan's default
keys.meaningEn: Turn dynamic workflows on or off for yourself when your plan's default isn't what you want. Appears in `/config` as **Dynamic workflows**, which writes this key to your user settings and removes it again when you toggle back to your plan's default. To turn workflows off for everyone from managed settings, use `disableWorkflows` instead.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns dynamic workflows on for you
`false`: Claude Code turns dynamic workflows off for you
keys.default: unset, so workflows are on unless you're on the Pro plan, where they're off
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS` turns workflows off for one session, and `true` here can't turn them back on while it's set

keys.zhMeaning: 让 /model 的 Default 选项也落在 availableModels 允许列表内。
keys.descEn: Keep the /model Default choice inside your availableModels allowlist
keys.meaningEn: The `/model` picker has a **Default** option that resolves to your organization default model when one applies, and otherwise to your account type's default. An `availableModels` allowlist limits the models you can name, but on its own it leaves **Default** alone, so **Default** can still resolve to a model outside the list. This key closes that gap. Requires Claude Code v2.1.175 or later.
typeValues: `true`: when **Default** would resolve to a model outside `availableModels`, Claude Code resolves it to the first available model in the list
`false`: **Default** resolves as usual, even to a model outside `availableModels`

keys.zhMeaning: 为每个会话及其子进程设置环境变量。
keys.descEn: Set environment variables for every session and its subprocesses
keys.meaningEn: Set environment variables for every session and for the subprocesses Claude Code starts from it. Any variable in the environment variables reference can go here, which is how you apply one to every session or roll it out to your team.
keys.type: object mapping variable names to string values

keys.zhMeaning: 按 Ctrl+G 编辑时，把 Claude 上一条回复以注释形式显示出来。
keys.descEn: Show Claude's last response as comments when you press Ctrl+G to edit
keys.meaningEn: When you press `Ctrl+G`, Claude Code opens the prompt you're typing in your external editor. With this key on, the editor buffer starts with Claude's previous response as `#` comment lines, so you can read it while you write, and Claude Code strips those lines when you save. Appears in `/config` as **Show last response in external editor**.
typeValues: `true`: the editor buffer starts with Claude's previous response as `#` comment lines, which Claude Code strips when you save
`false`: the editor buffer opens with only your prompt

keys.zhMeaning: 为仓库或组织注册插件市场。
keys.descEn: Register marketplaces for a repository or an organization
keys.meaningEn: Register additional plugin marketplaces by name, so that people who open the repository, or everyone your managed settings reach, get the marketplace without adding it themselves. Claude Code registers each marketplace it doesn't already know. Whether a plugin that `enabledPlugins` names from it installs depends on the plugin's source and which file enables it; that entry has the rules.
keys.type: object mapping a marketplace name to an object with a `source` object and an optional `autoUpdate` Boolean
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code honors entries in a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` only after you accept the workspace trust dialog for that folder; in a folder you haven't trusted, including a `-p` run there, it ignores them without a message.

keys.zhMeaning: 主模型过载时使用的备用模型链；该列表不合并。
keys.descEn: Name backup models for when the primary is overloaded
keys.meaningEn: Name backup models for Claude Code to try, in order, when your primary model is overloaded or unavailable. Claude Code switches to the next available model in the chain for the rest of the turn and shows a notice. Without a chain, Claude Code retries the same model and then surfaces the server's error, and you retry or switch models yourself.
keys.type: array of model aliases or IDs; `"default"` expands to the default model
keys.default: unset, so a failed request isn't retried on another model
keys.overrides: `--fallback-model` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 在可用会话中打开 fast mode。
keys.descEn: Turn fast mode on for sessions where it's available
keys.meaningEn: Turn fast mode on for sessions where it's available, for interactive work like rapid iteration or live debugging where you want speed at a higher cost per token. You don't usually edit this key by hand: running `/fast` writes `fastMode: true` to `~/.claude/settings.json`, and running it again to turn fast mode off removes the key. Fast mode runs only on Opus 5 and Opus 4.8: turning it on from another model switches you to Opus, and switching to an unsupported model turns it off. See Switch models while fast mode is on.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns fast mode on for sessions where it's available
`false`: fast mode stays off
keys.default: unset, so fast mode is off
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE` turns fast mode off for one session, and this key can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 要求每个人在每个会话里单独打开 fast mode。
keys.descEn: Require people to turn fast mode on each session
keys.meaningEn: Normally, running `/fast` saves `fastMode` to a person's user settings, so fast mode is on at the start of every later session. Set this key to `true` to stop that: a saved `fastMode: true` no longer turns fast mode on at session start, and each person has to run `/fast` in each session they want it. Claude Code leaves the `fastMode` key in their file, so turning this key off restores the old behavior. Owners on Team or Enterprise plans can deploy it organization-wide through server-managed settings.
typeValues: `true`: a saved `fastMode: true` no longer turns fast mode on at session start, so each person runs `/fast` in each session they want it; a `fastMode: true` passed with `--settings` still counts for that session unless managed settings set this key
`false`: a saved `fastMode: true` turns fast mode on at the start of every later session

keys.zhMeaning: 改变会话质量问卷出现的概率。
keys.descEn: Change how often the session quality survey appears
keys.meaningEn: Set the probability that the session quality survey appears when a session is eligible for it. Set `0` to keep the survey from appearing.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the rate Anthropic sets remotely, or its built-in rate of `0.005` on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry, which don't receive remote configuration
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY` set to `1` turns the survey off for one session whatever rate this key sets
keys.numeric: 官方：0 到 1 之间的概率。设为 0 关闭问卷。默认未设置，使用 Anthropic 远程配置的频率；Bedrock / Agent Platform / Foundry 上内置 0.005。

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭 /rewind 所恢复的文件快照。
keys.descEn: Turn off or on the file snapshots that /rewind restores
keys.meaningEn: Have Claude Code snapshot files before each edit so `/rewind` can restore them. Appears in `/config` as **Rewind code (checkpoints)**, and toggling it there writes this key to your user settings.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code snapshots files before each edit so `/rewind` can restore them
`false`: Claude Code doesn't snapshot files, so `/rewind` can't restore them
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING` turns checkpointing off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can't turn it back on

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令提供 @ 文件自动补全。
keys.descEn: Supply @ file autocomplete from your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command to supply `@` file path autocomplete instead of the built-in file suggestion. The built-in suggestion uses fast filesystem traversal; a large monorepo may do better with project-specific indexing such as a pre-built file index.
keys.type: object with `type`, always `"command"`, and `command`, the shell command to run
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in file suggestion
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Under the status line and file suggestion gates, Claude Code turns the command off or runs only a managed value, and skips yours without warning.

keys.zhMeaning: 把输出中的工单或评审 ID 变成输入框下方的可点击链接。
keys.descEn: Make issue or review IDs in output into clickable links below the input box
keys.meaningEn: Render extra clickable badges in the footer below the input box when a regex matches turn output: tool results, including file contents and fetched pages, and Claude's own responses. Use it to turn IDs printed by project CLIs, such as review tools and issue trackers, into session links. Requires Claude Code v2.1.176 or later.
keys.type: array of objects, each with `type` set to `"regex"`, a `pattern` regex, a `url` template, and an optional `label`; `{name}` placeholders in `url` and `label` are filled from named capture groups in `pattern`

keys.zhMeaning: 设置登录页连接的网关 URL。
keys.descEn: Set the gateway URL the login screen connects to
keys.meaningEn: Set the gateway URL the `/login` Cloud gateway screen connects to, so people reach your cloud gateway without typing its address. The screen has no URL field: with this key set, it shows your gateway URL and connects when the person presses Enter; without it, it tells them to contact their IT administrator. When `forceLoginMethod` is unset, this key alone opens the Cloud gateway screen. `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` also opens it and removes the login-method picker, and a `claudeai` or `console` value there takes precedence over this key. Set both keys so the screen connects instead of showing an error.
keys.type: string, a full URL including the scheme
keys.default: unset, so the Cloud gateway screen shows an error telling people to contact their IT administrator
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Read only from a source on the machine: `managed-settings.json`, the macOS plist or Windows HKLM registry, or a policy helper. Claude Code ignores it in HKCU and server-managed settings.

keys.zhMeaning: 把登录限制为 claude.ai、Claude Console 或云网关。
keys.descEn: Restrict login to claude.ai, Claude Console, or a cloud gateway
keys.meaningEn: Restrict which kind of account people can log in with. Set `"claudeai"` to allow only claude.ai accounts, `"console"` to allow only Claude Console accounts, or `"gateway"` to send people to a cloud gateway instead of a first-party login. Administrators set it in managed settings and pair it with `forceLoginOrgUUID` to keep developers' claude.ai logins inside one organization.
typeValues: `"claudeai"`: only claude.ai accounts can log in
`"console"`: only Claude Console accounts can log in
`"gateway"`: Claude Code sends people to a cloud gateway instead of a first-party login
keys.default: unset, so people pick a login method
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code honors `"gateway"` only from a managed source on the machine: `managed-settings.json`, the macOS plist or Windows HKLM registry, or a policy helper. It treats `"gateway"` as unset in user, project, local, HKCU, and server-managed settings, the same rule as `forceLoginGatewayUrl`.

keys.zhMeaning: 把 claude.ai 登录钉在指定组织；只有托管来源才会强制执行。
keys.descEn: Pin claude.ai logins to your organization; only a managed source enforces it
keys.meaningEn: From a managed source, require claude.ai account logins to belong to one Anthropic organization, a single UUID, or to any of several, an array. From any settings file, a single UUID also pre-selects that organization during a claude.ai or Claude Console login; an array pre-selects nothing.
keys.type: string, one UUID, or array of strings, several UUIDs
keys.default: unset, so any organization can log in
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Only a managed source enforces the restriction; a single UUID in any other settings file pre-selects the organization during login without restricting it.

keys.zhMeaning: 在尚未新鲜拉取 server-managed settings 前阻止启动。
keys.descEn: Block startup until server-managed settings are freshly fetched
keys.meaningEn: Block CLI startup until Claude Code has freshly fetched server-managed settings. If the fetch fails, Claude Code exits instead of continuing with cached or no settings. When the key is unset, startup continues without waiting for remote settings. A Cloud gateway session always waits, and exits if the gateway can't be reached. Set it when your environment can't accept even a brief window in which a session runs without its managed policy.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code blocks startup until it has freshly fetched server-managed settings, and exits if the fetch fails
`false`: startup continues without waiting for remote settings
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Claude Code honors a `true` from any admin-controlled managed source, even one that isn't the highest-priority source.

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令刷新 Google Cloud 凭证。
keys.descEn: Refresh Google Cloud credentials with your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command to refresh Google Cloud Application Default Credentials when Claude Code finds they've expired or can't be loaded, so Google Cloud's Agent Platform requests keep working without you re-authenticating by hand.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code's credential error tells you to run `gcloud auth application-default login` yourself

keys.zhMeaning: 在 Claude Code 生命周期节点运行你自己的命令。
keys.descEn: Run your own commands as hooks at points in Claude Code's lifecycle
keys.meaningEn: Run your own commands, prompts, agents, HTTP requests, or MCP tools as hooks at points in Claude Code's lifecycle, such as before a tool call or when a session starts; the hooks reference lists every event, its payload, and its exit codes. Each event maps to a list of matcher groups, and each group lists the handlers to run when the matcher applies.
keys.type: object keyed by hook event; each value is an array of `{ "matcher", "hooks" }` groups whose `hooks` entries have a `type` of `"command"`, `"prompt"`, `"agent"`, `"http"`, or `"mcp_tool"`
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Hooks merge across files rather than replacing each other, and hooks from managed settings can't be removed from other files.

keys.zhName: HTTP 钩子允许的环境变量
keys.zhMeaning: 限制 HTTP hooks 可以放进请求头的环境变量。
keys.descEn: Limit which env vars HTTP hooks can put in headers
keys.meaningEn: An HTTP hook can put the value of an environment variable into a request header, for example an `Authorization: Bearer $HOOK_TOKEN` header, but only for variables the hook lists in its own `allowedEnvVars`. This key sets an outer limit on that list for every HTTP hook: a hook can use a variable only if both its own `allowedEnvVars` and this key name it. Use it to stop a hook from reading a secret it shouldn't, even when the hook's definition asks for it.
keys.default: unset, so each hook's own `allowedEnvVars` list applies
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Arrays merge across settings files.

keys.zhMeaning: 已弃用；请改用 attribution 来隐藏或更改提交与 PR 署名。
keys.descEn: Deprecated; use attribution to hide or change commit and PR attribution
keys.meaningEn: Deprecated since v2.0.62, when `attribution` replaced it. Claude Code still reads it, but new configurations should set `attribution`.
typeValues: `true`: the same as unset; Claude Code adds the commit trailer and the pull request attribution text
`false`: Claude Code omits both the commit trailer and the pull request attribution text, unless `attribution` sets `commit` or `pr`, in which case the `attribution` rules apply

keys.zhMeaning: 从系统提示中移除内置的提交和 PR 说明。
keys.descEn: Remove the built-in commit and PR instructions from the system prompt
keys.meaningEn: At session start, Claude Code adds two git-related pieces to Claude's prompt: its built-in instructions for how to write commits and pull requests, in the Bash tool's description, and a git status snapshot of your repository in the system prompt, meaning the current branch, the main branch, `git status` output, and recent commits. Set this key to `false` to leave both out, for example when you use your own git workflow skills.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code includes its built-in commit and pull request workflow instructions and the git status snapshot. Cloud sessions never include the snapshot
`false`: Claude Code leaves both out
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 当 Claude 在等你时发送推送通知。
keys.descEn: Get a push notification when Claude is waiting on you
keys.meaningEn: Get a push notification on your phone when a permission prompt or question is waiting for your input. Claude Code sends these only while Remote Control is connected. Appears in `/config` as **Push when actions required**.
typeValues: `true`: you get a push notification on your phone when a permission prompt or question is waiting, while Remote Control is connected
`false`: Claude Code sends no such notifications
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code also reads a value left in `~/.claude.json` by older versions.

keys.zhMeaning: Claude 向另一台机器上的会话发消息前先询问你。
keys.descEn: Ask you before Claude messages one of your sessions on another machine
keys.meaningEn: Require your explicit approval before Claude's `SendMessage` reaches one of your sessions beyond this machine; see Require approval for cross-machine messages. The approval prompt appears even in `bypassPermissions` mode.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code asks for your approval before Claude's `SendMessage` reaches one of your sessions beyond this machine
`false`: cross-machine messages don't prompt
keys.default: unset, so cross-machine messages don't prompt
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A `true` from any scope applies, so a checked-in project file can turn the requirement on but not off.

keys.zhMeaning: 让 Ctrl+W 像 Bash 一样删回到上一处空白。
keys.descEn: Make Ctrl+W delete back to the previous whitespace, as Bash does
keys.meaningEn: Choose which convention `Ctrl+W` follows in the prompt input. Set it to `"readline"` to make `Ctrl+W` delete back to the previous whitespace, as Bash does, so a path or a `--flag=value` goes in one press. Requires Claude Code v2.1.238 or later.
typeValues: `"classic"`: `Ctrl+W` deletes the previous word
`"readline"`: `Ctrl+W` deletes back to the previous whitespace

keys.zhMeaning: 让 Claude 用英语以外的语言回复。
keys.descEn: Have Claude respond in a language other than English
keys.meaningEn: Have Claude respond in a language other than English by default. There is no fixed list for responses: Claude Code adds the value verbatim to the system prompt as an instruction to always respond in that language, so any language name Claude can read works. Claude Code doesn't check the value, so a misspelled name reaches Claude as written rather than producing an error. The same value sets the language for voice dictation, which does have a fixed list of supported dictation languages, and for auto-generated session titles.
keys.type: string, any language name, such as `"japanese"`, `"spanish"`, or `"french"`; Claude Code doesn't validate it
keys.default: unset; session titles then match the language of your conversation

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止自动更新安装低于该版本的版本。
keys.descEn: Keep auto-updates from installing anything below a version
keys.meaningEn: Keep background auto-updates and `claude update` from installing any version below this one, so moving to the `"stable"` channel doesn't downgrade you from a newer `"latest"` build. Claude Code writes this key for you when you choose to stay on your current version while switching channels in `/config`, and clears it when you switch back to `"latest"`.
keys.type: string, a version number such as `"2.1.100"`
keys.default: unset, so updates can install any version the channel offers
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Set it in managed settings to pin an organization-wide minimum that user and project settings can't lower.

keys.zhMeaning: 更改 Claude Code 新会话启动时使用的模型。
keys.descEn: Change the model Claude Code starts with
keys.meaningEn: Set the model every new session uses, so you don't have to pick one with `/model` each time. Setting it here doesn't stop you from switching mid-session. If your admin set an organization default model to override user selection, you get that model even when you set this key in user, project, or local settings.
keys.type: string, a model alias or full model ID
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses your account's default model
keys.overrides: `--model` takes precedence over `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`, and both take precedence over this key for one session, including over a managed `model`; an `availableModels` list still applies to the pick

keys.zhMeaning: 把模型 ID 映射到提供商自己的 ID，例如 Bedrock ARN。
keys.descEn: Map model IDs to your provider's IDs, such as Bedrock ARNs
keys.meaningEn: Map Anthropic model IDs to provider-specific model IDs, such as Amazon Bedrock inference profile ARNs. Each model picker entry then uses its mapped value when calling the provider API. Administrators use this on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry to route each model version to a specific inference profile, version name, or deployment for governance, cost allocation, or regional routing.
keys.type: object mapping model ID to provider model ID

keys.zhMeaning: 自定义 /model 选择器列出的模型、顺序和标签；该列表不合并。
keys.descEn: Choose which models the /model picker lists, in your own order and with your own labels
keys.meaningEn: List the models the `/model` picker offers, in the order you write them and under labels you choose, so the picker lists the models your organization runs, after the built-in lineup or instead of it. Each row's `model` is taken verbatim, so it accepts anything `--model` accepts: an alias such as `opus`, an Anthropic model ID, or a provider-format ID for Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, or an LLM gateway. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.
keys.type: object with an `options` array of rows and an optional `replaceBuiltInOptions` Boolean
keys.default: unset, so the picker shows the built-in lineup
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. Claude Code reads the key from managed settings, `--settings`, and user settings, and ignores it in project and local settings so a repository you clone can't relabel the picker. The highest of those three that sets the key supplies the whole lineup, and Claude Code never combines lineups from two sources.

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令生成轮换的 OpenTelemetry 请求头。
keys.descEn: Generate rotating OpenTelemetry headers with your own command
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command to generate the headers Claude Code sends with OpenTelemetry exports, for backends whose tokens rotate. Claude Code runs it at startup and periodically after that, and expects a JSON object of string header values on stdout.
keys.type: string, an executable path or a shell command line
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code adds no helper-generated headers

keys.zhMeaning: 用 output style 改变 Claude 的角色、语气和输出格式。
keys.descEn: Change Claude's role, tone, and output format with an output style
keys.meaningEn: Select an output style by name. An output style is a saved set of instructions that Claude Code adds to the system prompt to change Claude's role, tone, and output format, such as the built-in Explanatory and Learning styles or one you wrote yourself.
keys.type: string, the name of a built-in or custom output style
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the default style

keys.zhMeaning: 决定是否应用 SDK 或 IDE 宿主传入的托管策略限制。
keys.descEn: Apply or drop restrictions an SDK or IDE host passes when you deploy managed settings
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether Claude Code applies managed settings supplied by an embedding host process, such as the Agent SDK or an IDE extension, when an admin-deployed managed tier is also present. With `"first-wins"`, Claude Code drops the host-supplied settings; with `"merge"`, it applies them under the admin tier through a restrictive-only filter. Set `"merge"` when a host needs to pass its own restrictions to the sessions it launches, for example Claude Desktop delivering a gateway's egress allowlist.
typeValues: `"first-wins"`: Claude Code drops the host-supplied settings when an admin-deployed managed tier is present
`"merge"`: Claude Code applies the host-supplied settings under the admin tier through a restrictive-only filter
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Claude Code reads it from the highest-priority admin-controlled managed source.

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭 shell 权限提示上的 Ctrl+E 命令解释。
keys.descEn: Turn off the Ctrl+E command explanation on shell permission prompts
keys.meaningEn: When Claude asks permission to run a Bash or PowerShell command, you can press `Ctrl+E` on the prompt to get a model-generated explanation of the command: what it does, why Claude is running it, and what could go wrong, labeled **Low risk**, **Med risk**, or **High risk**. Claude Code asks the model for the explanation only when you press the shortcut, and showing it doesn't run the command. Set this key to `false` to turn the shortcut off.
typeValues: `true`: you can press `Ctrl+E` on a Bash or PowerShell permission prompt to get a model-generated explanation of the command
`false`: Claude Code turns the `Ctrl+E` shortcut off

keys.zhMeaning: 设置 allow / ask / deny 规则以及会话起始权限模式。
keys.descEn: Set allow, ask, and deny rules and the starting permission mode
keys.meaningEn: Control which tools Claude can use without asking, which ones always prompt, and which ones are blocked, and set the permission mode a session starts in. Every `permissions.*` key below nests under this object.

keys.zhMeaning: 让 Claude 访问当前目录以外的目录。
keys.descEn: Give Claude file access to directories outside the current one
keys.meaningEn: Give Claude file access to directories outside the one you started in, as additional working directories. Most `.claude/` configuration is not discovered from these directories.
keys.overrides: `--add-dir` and `/add-dir` add directories for one session alongside this key

keys.zhMeaning: 列出的工具调用无需再提示即可执行。
keys.descEn: Approve listed tool uses without a prompt
keys.meaningEn: List the tool uses Claude Code approves without asking you. In an MCP rule, `*` can appear only in the tool name after the `mcp__<server>__` prefix, such as `mcp__github__get_*`; it can't appear in the server name.
keys.overrides: `--allowedTools` adds allow rules for one session, and a deny rule from any settings file still blocks a tool it names

keys.zhMeaning: 列出的工具调用始终先提示。
keys.descEn: Always prompt before listed tool uses
keys.meaningEn: List the tool uses that prompt you for confirmation even in a permission mode that would otherwise approve them, such as `acceptEdits` or `bypassPermissions`. In `dontAsk` mode Claude Code denies a matching tool use instead of prompting.

keys.zhMeaning: 设置新会话启动时的权限模式。
keys.descEn: Set the permission mode new sessions start in
keys.meaningEn: Set the permission mode new sessions start in. When you leave it unset, sessions start in the built-in default for your plan and surface.
typeValues: `"default"`: Claude Code runs only reads without asking
`"acceptEdits"`: Claude Code also runs file edits and common filesystem commands such as `mkdir` and `mv` without asking
`"plan"`: Claude Code reads and plans but blocks edits until you approve a plan
`"auto"`: Claude Code runs everything, with background safety checks
`"dontAsk"`: Claude Code runs only pre-approved tools and auto-denies every call that would otherwise prompt
`"bypassPermissions"`: Claude Code runs everything without asking
`"manual"`: an alias for `"default"`, in Claude Code v2.1.200 or later
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. `auto` doesn't take effect from project or local settings, so set it in `~/.claude/settings.json` instead. Conversations the VS Code extension starts read only user, managed, and `--settings` values.
keys.overrides: `--permission-mode`, and its equivalent `--dangerously-skip-permissions` for `bypassPermissions`, take precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止列出的工具调用，包括读取含密钥的文件。
keys.descEn: Block listed tool uses, including reads of files that hold secrets
keys.meaningEn: List the tool uses Claude Code blocks. Use it for files that hold API keys, secrets, or environment values: Claude Code excludes matching files from file discovery and search results, denies reads of them, and blocks the Edit and Write tools on the matching paths. Read and Edit deny rules apply to Claude's built-in file tools and to file commands Claude Code recognizes in Bash, such as `cat`, `head`, `tail`, and `sed`; they don't apply to arbitrary subprocesses, so for OS-level enforcement enable the sandbox.
keys.overrides: `--disallowedTools` adds deny rules for one session alongside this key

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止任何人进入 bypassPermissions 模式。
keys.descEn: Prevent anyone from entering bypassPermissions mode
keys.meaningEn: Prevent anyone from entering `bypassPermissions` mode. Claude Code then rejects the `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flag, and ignores an agent definition's `permissionMode: bypassPermissions`, so the subagent runs with the parent session's permission mode.
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Typically set in managed settings to enforce organizational policy.
keys.overrides: this key takes precedence over `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, which Claude Code rejects while the key is set

keys.zhMeaning: 选择 plan mode 写入计划文件的位置。
keys.descEn: Choose where plan mode writes plan files
keys.meaningEn: Choose where Claude Code stores the plan files it writes in plan mode. Claude Code resolves the path relative to the project root and keeps the default when the path resolves outside it.
keys.type: string, a path relative to the project root

keys.zhMeaning: 保存你在插件配置对话框里给出的答案。
keys.descEn: Store the answers you gave a plugin's configuration dialog
keys.meaningEn: Store the non-sensitive answers you give a plugin's `userConfig` configuration dialog, keyed by plugin ID. Claude Code writes this key to your user settings when you fill in the dialog, so you don't need to edit it by hand. Sensitive options go to the macOS Keychain instead, or to `~/.claude/.credentials.json` on platforms without a supported keychain.
keys.type: object mapping a plugin ID to an object with an `options` field, mapping each option name to a string, number, Boolean, or array of strings, and an optional `mcpServers` field holding per-server user configuration values in the same shape

keys.zhMeaning: 选择哪些市场可以在 /plugin 里弹出安装建议。
keys.descEn: Choose which marketplaces can surface plugin install suggestions in /plugin
keys.meaningEn: Name the marketplaces whose plugins can appear as contextual install suggestions, in spinner tips and pinned at the top of the `/plugin` **Discover** tab. The built-in first-party frontend-design tip is unaffected. Suggestions come from each plugin's `relevance` declaration in its marketplace entry.
keys.default: unset, so no marketplace-declared suggestions surface

keys.zhMeaning: 在插件信任警告中追加你自己的文字。
keys.descEn: Add your own text to the plugin trust warning
keys.meaningEn: Add your organization's own text to the plugin trust warning Claude Code shows before installation, for example to confirm that plugins from your internal marketplace are vetted.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code shows the standard warning alone

keys.zhMeaning: 启动时运行可执行文件来计算托管设置。
keys.descEn: Run an executable that computes managed settings at startup
keys.meaningEn: Run an executable you deploy that computes managed settings at startup, so you can derive policy from device posture, identity, or a remote service instead of a static file. Claude Code runs the helper before it accepts the first prompt and treats the settings it emits as the managed settings for the session.
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Read from the macOS plist, the Windows HKLM registry, or the managed settings file. Claude Code reads the key from the highest-priority managed source that delivers settings and runs the helper only when that source is one of those three; it ignores the key in server-managed settings, the HKCU registry, and host-supplied parent settings.

keys.zhMeaning: 指定 Claude Code 运行的 helper 可执行文件。
keys.descEn: Name the helper executable Claude Code runs
keys.meaningEn: Name the helper executable Claude Code runs. Claude Code refuses to start when the path isn't absolute, or on Windows when it doesn't end in `.exe`.
keys.type: string, an absolute path in normalized form, without `.` or `..` segments
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Read from the macOS plist, the Windows HKLM registry, or the managed settings file, wherever `policyHelper` is read.

keys.zhMeaning: 按间隔在后台重新运行 helper，单位是毫秒。
keys.descEn: Re-run the helper in the background on an interval
keys.meaningEn: Have Claude Code re-run the helper in the background on an interval so policy changes reach a running session. When a refresh succeeds, its output replaces the previous managed settings without a restart; when a refresh fails, Claude Code keeps the policy it already has.
