keys.type: integer, milliseconds: `0` to disable refresh, otherwise at least `60000`
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code runs the helper once at startup
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Read from the macOS plist, the Windows HKLM registry, or the managed settings file, wherever `policyHelper` is read.
keys.numeric: 官方：整数毫秒。0 关闭刷新；否则至少 60000。默认未设置，只在启动时运行一次。

keys.zhMeaning: 等待 helper 的最长时间，单位是毫秒。
keys.descEn: Set how long Claude Code waits for the helper
keys.meaningEn: Set how long Claude Code waits for the helper before treating the run as failed. A timed-out run fails the same way as a non-zero exit, so at startup Claude Code refuses to start.
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Read from the macOS plist, the Windows HKLM registry, or the managed settings file, wherever `policyHelper` is read.
keys.numeric: 官方：整数毫秒，最小 1000。默认 10000。

keys.zhMeaning: 任务完成时选择终端铃或桌面通知。
keys.descEn: Choose a terminal bell or desktop notification for task completion
keys.meaningEn: Choose how Claude Code notifies you when a task completes or a permission prompt is waiting. Appears in `/config` as **Local notifications**.
typeValues: `"auto"`: Claude Code sends a desktop notification in iTerm2, Ghostty, and Kitty, rings the bell in Terminal.app only when its audible bell is off, and does nothing elsewhere
`"terminal_bell"`: Claude Code rings the bell character in any terminal
`"iterm2"`: Claude Code sends an iTerm2 desktop notification
`"iterm2_with_bell"`: Claude Code sends an iTerm2 desktop notification and rings the bell
`"kitty"`: Claude Code sends a Kitty desktop notification
`"ghostty"`: Claude Code sends a Ghostty desktop notification
`"notifications_disabled"`: Claude Code sends no notification
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code also reads a value left in `~/.claude.json` by older versions.

keys.zhMeaning: 减弱或关闭转圈、闪烁等动画。
keys.descEn: Reduce or turn off spinner, shimmer, and flash animations
keys.meaningEn: Reduce or turn off interface animations such as the spinner, shimmer, and flash effects. Appears in `/config` as **Reduce motion**.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code reduces or turns off interface animations such as the spinner, shimmer, and flash effects
`false`: the same as unset; Claude Code shows its animations

keys.zhMeaning: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上通过企业启动器运行后台进程。
keys.descEn: Run Claude Code's background processes through a corporate launcher on macOS and Linux
keys.meaningEn: On macOS and Linux, place a corporate launcher command in front of the background processes Claude Code starts. Claude Code runs the launcher with its own command line appended, so the launcher must exec into Claude Code; see Run Claude Code behind a corporate launcher for the launcher contract. Requires Claude Code v2.1.210 or later.
keys.type: string, the launcher command as an argv prefix, such as an absolute path with optional arguments
keys.default: unset, so background processes start unwrapped
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 选择主对话 prompt cache 的寿命；取值是 "5m" 或 "1h"，不是原始数字。
keys.descEn: Choose the prompt cache lifetime for the main conversation
keys.meaningEn: Choose how long the prompt cache holds the main conversation. This key applies to your interactive, `-p`, and Agent SDK turns, together with the helpers Claude Code runs inline with them. The one-hour lifetime keeps the cache warm across longer breaks, and the API bills each cache write at a higher rate than at the five-minute lifetime. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.
typeValues: `"5m"`: the cache holds for five minutes
`"1h"`: the cache holds for an hour
keys.default: unset, so each main-conversation request gets its default lifetime
keys.overrides: `FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M` takes precedence over everything else, then `CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL`, then this key, and last `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`
keys.numeric: 官方取值是字符串 "5m" 或 "1h"，不是原始数字。默认未设置，沿用各请求自己的默认寿命。

keys.zhMeaning: 显示或隐藏输入框里灰色的 prompt suggestions。
keys.descEn: Hide the grayed-out prompt suggestions in the input box
keys.meaningEn: Show or hide prompt suggestions, the grayed-out predictions that appear in your prompt input. Set it to `false`, or turn off **Prompt suggestions** in `/config`, to hide them.
typeValues: `true`: you see prompt suggestions in your prompt input
`false`: Claude Code hides prompt suggestions
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 把 PR 链接指向内部代码评审工具，而不是 github.com。
keys.descEn: Point PR links at an internal code-review tool instead of github.com
keys.meaningEn: Point the PR links Claude Code renders, in the footer badge and in tool-result summaries, at an internal code-review tool instead of `github.com`. Claude Code substitutes `{host}`, `{owner}`, `{repo}`, `{number}`, and `{url}` from the `gh`-reported PR URL. The GitLab merge request badge keeps its GitLab URL.
keys.type: string, a URL template using any of the five placeholders
keys.default: unset, so links use the `gh`-reported URL

keys.zhMeaning: 为 claude --cloud 选择默认云环境。
keys.descEn: Pick the default cloud environment for claude --cloud; a self-hosted ccpool_ ID is read only from user and managed settings and --settings
keys.meaningEn: Pick the default cloud environment for cloud sessions you create from the CLI, such as with `claude --cloud`. Claude Code writes this key to your user settings when you pick an environment with `/remote-env`.
keys.type: string, an environment ID such as `env_...` or `ccpool_...`
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the Anthropic-hosted environment when one is in your list, and otherwise the first environment it finds
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. For a self-hosted environment ID, user or managed settings, or the `--settings` flag only.
keys.overrides: `--environment` takes precedence over this key for the one cloud session it creates

keys.zhMeaning: 会话开始时自动连接 Remote Control。
keys.descEn: Connect Remote Control automatically when a session starts
keys.meaningEn: Connect Remote Control automatically when each interactive session starts, instead of waiting for `/remote-control`. Set it to `true` to turn auto-connect on, `false` to turn it off. Appears in `/config` as **Enable Remote Control for all sessions**.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code connects Remote Control automatically when each interactive session starts
`false`: Claude Code waits for `/remote-control`
keys.default: unset, so auto-connect follows your organization's admin default when one is set, and otherwise Claude Code's current default
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code also reads a value left in `~/.claude.json` by older versions.
keys.overrides: `--remote-control` turns Remote Control on for one session even when this key is `false`, and no flag turns it off for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 版本新于组织允许值时拒绝启动。
keys.descEn: Refuse to start on a version newer than your organization allows
keys.meaningEn: Set the newest Claude Code version your organization allows to start. When the running version is newer, Claude Code exits at startup and tells the user to install an approved version through your organization's approved method; `claude install <version>` may also work. Requires Claude Code v2.1.163 or later.
keys.type: string, a version number such as `"2.1.150"`; a value that isn't a valid version is ignored
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Claude Code gives no warning when it ignores the key elsewhere.

keys.zhMeaning: 版本旧于组织要求时拒绝启动。
keys.descEn: Refuse to start on a version older than your organization requires
keys.meaningEn: Set the oldest Claude Code version your organization allows to start. When the running version is older, Claude Code exits at startup and tells the user to update through your organization's approved method. The check runs at startup only, so a session that's already running continues. Requires Claude Code v2.1.163 or later.
keys.type: string, a version number such as `"2.1.150"`; a value that isn't a valid version is ignored
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Claude Code gives no warning when it ignores the key elsewhere.

keys.zhMeaning: 让 @ 文件选择器排除被 gitignore 的文件。
keys.descEn: Keep gitignored files out of the @ file picker
keys.meaningEn: Control whether the `@` file picker leaves out files that match `.gitignore` patterns. Appears in `/config` as **Respect .gitignore in file picker**.
typeValues: `true`: the `@` file picker leaves out files that match `.gitignore` patterns
`false`: the `@` file picker includes files that match `.gitignore` patterns
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. When no settings file sets it, Claude Code falls back to `respectGitignore` in `~/.claude.json`, which the `/config` toggle writes.

keys.zhMeaning: 在 ! shell 命令运行后，决定 Claude 是否继续回复。
keys.descEn: Stop Claude from responding after a ! shell command runs
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether Claude responds after you run a shell command with the `!` prefix in the input box. By default, Claude Code adds the command's output to the conversation and Claude replies to it. Set this key to `false` to add the output to context without a reply, so you can run several commands and ask about them together. Requires Claude Code v2.1.186 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code adds the command's output to the conversation and Claude replies to it
`false`: Claude Code adds the output to context without a reply

keys.zhMeaning: 在 macOS、Linux 和 WSL2 上把 Bash 命令与文件系统、网络隔离。
keys.descEn: Isolate Bash commands from your filesystem and network on macOS, Linux, and WSL2
keys.meaningEn: Isolate the Bash commands Claude runs from your filesystem and network with sandboxing. Turn the sandbox on with `enabled`, then narrow or widen what sandboxed commands can touch with the `filesystem`, `network`, and `credentials` sub-objects. The sandbox runs on macOS, Linux, and WSL2.
keys.type: object with `enabled`, `failIfUnavailable`, `autoAllowBashIfSandboxed`, `excludedCommands`, `allowUnsandboxedCommands`, `enableWeakerNestedSandbox`, `enableWeakerNetworkIsolation`, `allowAppleEvents`, `bwrapPath`, `socatPath`, `ignoreViolations`, and `ripgrep`, plus the `filesystem`, `network`, and `credentials` objects
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code runs commands without a sandbox

keys.zhMeaning: 允许沙箱内命令在 macOS 上发送 Apple Events。
keys.descEn: Let sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
keys.meaningEn: Let sandboxed commands on macOS send Apple Events, which `open`, `osascript`, and tools that open URLs in a browser need; without it they fail with error `-600`. This removes code-execution isolation: sandboxed commands can launch other applications unsandboxed with no user prompt, and can send AppleScript commands to running applications such as Terminal, subject to the per-app macOS automation-consent prompt (TCC).
typeValues: `true`: sandboxed commands on macOS can send Apple Events
`false`: sandboxed commands on macOS can't send Apple Events, so `open` and `osascript` fail with error `-600`

keys.zhMeaning: 允许 Claude 在沙箱拦截后到沙箱外重试，或禁止这样做。
keys.descEn: Let Claude retry a blocked command outside the sandbox, or forbid it
keys.meaningEn: Let Claude retry a command outside the sandbox with the `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` parameter after the sandbox blocks it. Set it to `false` so Claude Code ignores that parameter completely and every command must run sandboxed or appear in `excludedCommands`, which the `/sandbox` **Overrides** tab shows as **Strict sandbox mode**. Use `false` in managed settings for policies that require strict sandboxing.
typeValues: `true`: Claude can retry a command outside the sandbox with the `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` parameter after the sandbox blocks it
`false`: Claude Code ignores that parameter, so every command runs sandboxed or appears in `excludedCommands`

keys.zhMeaning: 已沙箱的命令不再弹出权限提示。
keys.descEn: Run sandboxed commands without a permission prompt
keys.meaningEn: Let Claude Code run sandboxed Bash commands without a permission prompt. Commands that can't run in the sandbox still go through the regular permission flow, and `deny` rules and content-scoped `ask` rules such as `Bash(git push *)` still apply; a bare `Bash` ask rule is skipped for sandboxed commands. Set it to `false` to send sandboxed commands through the regular permission flow too, which the `/sandbox` **Mode** tab calls regular permissions mode.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code runs sandboxed Bash commands without a permission prompt, subject to `deny` rules and content-scoped `ask` rules; `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` turns auto-allow off
`false`: sandboxed commands go through the regular permission flow, so your allow rules and permission mode decide. The `/sandbox` **Mode** tab calls this regular permissions mode

keys.zhMeaning: 指向 PATH 之外的 bubblewrap 二进制。
keys.descEn: Point the sandbox at a bubblewrap binary outside PATH
keys.meaningEn: Point the sandbox at a bubblewrap binary installed outside `PATH`, such as a vendored copy on an air-gapped host. Claude Code uses the path both for the startup dependency check and when it wraps each sandboxed command.
keys.type: string, an absolute path; Claude Code drops a relative path and falls back to `PATH` lookup
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code finds `bwrap` on `PATH`
keys.scopeDetail: `Managed`. Claude Code reads it only from managed settings so that a user, project, or local file can't point the sandbox at a different binary.

keys.zhMeaning: 在沙箱内隐藏或掩码凭证文件与变量。
keys.descEn: Hide or mask credential files and variables inside the sandbox
keys.meaningEn: Declare the credential files and environment variables to protect from sandboxed commands. Each entry names a file `path` or a variable `name` and a `mode`: `deny` hides the credential inside the sandbox, and `mask` shows sandboxed commands a placeholder while the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on outbound requests. Claude Code protects only the entries you list; there is no built-in credential deny list. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later.
keys.default: unset, so no credentials are protected
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. `deny` entries merge from every scope, and Claude Code honors `mask` entries, `allowPlaintextInject`, `awsPairs`, and `sigv4` only from user settings, managed settings, and the `--settings` flag.

keys.zhMeaning: 允许被掩码的凭证到达受信任测试网络上的明文 HTTP 服务。
keys.descEn: Let masked credentials reach plain HTTP services on trusted test networks
keys.meaningEn: Allow `mask` substitution on plain HTTP requests as well as TLS-terminated HTTPS. On plain HTTP the upstream identity is unverified and the credential travels in cleartext, so leave this off outside trusted test networks. Requires Claude Code v2.1.199 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code allows `mask` substitution on plain HTTP requests as well as TLS-terminated HTTPS
`false`: Claude Code allows `mask` substitution only on TLS-terminated HTTPS

keys.zhMeaning: 把自定义命名的 AWS 密钥变量连成一组，便于重新签名。
keys.descEn: Link custom-named AWS key variables into one credential for re-signing
keys.meaningEn: Group masked environment variables that form one AWS credential for SigV4 re-signing when your credential lives in variables with non-standard names. Claude Code links the conventional `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, and `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` trio automatically when you mask their whole values, so you need this key only for other names. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.
keys.type: array of objects, each with `accessKeyIdVar`, `secretAccessKeyVar`, and optionally `sessionTokenVar`, naming `sandbox.credentials.envVars` entries
keys.default: unset, so only the conventional trio is paired

keys.zhMeaning: 在沙箱内取消设置或掩码某个环境变量。
keys.descEn: Unset or mask an environment variable inside the sandbox
keys.meaningEn: Protect environment variables from sandboxed commands. With `"mode": "deny"`, Claude Code removes the variable from the environment of sandboxed commands. With `"mode": "mask"`, sandboxed commands see a per-session sentinel value, and the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on outbound requests to that entry's `injectHosts`, so tools such as `gh` and `npm` keep authenticating without ever holding the real credential. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later, and `"mode": "mask"` requires v2.1.199 or later.
keys.type: array of objects, each with `name` and a `mode` of `"deny"` or `"mask"`, plus the optional mask fields for environment variables
keys.default: unset, so no environment variables are protected
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code drops `mask` entries from project `.claude/settings.json` and local `.claude/settings.local.json`.

keys.zhMeaning: 在沙箱内阻止或掩码读取某个凭证文件。
keys.descEn: Block or mask reads of a credential file inside the sandbox
keys.meaningEn: Protect credential files or directories from sandboxed commands. With `"mode": "deny"`, Claude Code blocks reads of the path inside the sandbox, the same read block as `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead`. With `"mode": "mask"`, sandboxed commands on Linux and WSL2 read a sentinel copy of the file, and the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on outbound requests to that entry's `injectHosts`; on macOS the file is unreadable inside the sandbox instead. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later, and `"mode": "mask"` requires v2.1.221 or later.
keys.type: array of objects, each with `path` and a `mode` of `"deny"` or `"mask"`, plus the optional mask fields for files
keys.default: unset, so no credential files are protected
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code drops `mask` entries from project `.claude/settings.json` and local `.claude/settings.local.json`.

keys.zhMeaning: 选择流式、预签名或 SigV4A AWS 请求是失败还是放行。
keys.descEn: Choose whether streaming, presigned, or SigV4A AWS requests fail or pass through
keys.meaningEn: Choose what the sandbox proxy does with AWS request forms it can't re-sign: `streaming` for aws-chunked streaming uploads, `presigned` for presigned URLs, and `sigv4a` for SigV4A asymmetric signatures. This applies only to requests signed with a masked pair's placeholder access key ID. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.
keys.type: object with `streaming`, `presigned`, and `sigv4a`, each one of:
typeValues: `"deny"`: the proxy fails the request
`"passthrough"`: the proxy forwards the request signed with the masked placeholder, so the tool receives AWS's own rejection

keys.zhMeaning: 在 macOS、Linux 和 WSL2 上打开 Bash 沙箱。
keys.descEn: Turn on Bash sandboxing on macOS, Linux, and WSL2
keys.meaningEn: Turn on sandboxing for Bash commands. When you pick a mode in the `/sandbox` panel, Claude Code writes this key to `.claude/settings.local.json` for the current project; set it in `~/.claude/settings.json` to sandbox every project.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code sandboxes Bash commands
`false`: Bash commands run unsandboxed

keys.zhMeaning: 在非特权容器内运行 Linux 沙箱。
keys.descEn: Run the Linux sandbox inside an unprivileged container
keys.meaningEn: Run the Linux sandbox inside an unprivileged Docker container, where bubblewrap can't mount a fresh `/proc`. Instead the inner sandbox bind-mounts the container's existing `/proc`, which exposes process information that a fresh mount would hide. This reduces security; use it only when the outer container already provides the isolation you need.
typeValues: `true`: the inner sandbox bind-mounts the container's existing `/proc` instead of mounting a fresh one
`false`: the sandbox mounts a fresh `/proc`, which doesn't work in an unprivileged Docker container

keys.zhMeaning: 让 gh、gcloud、terraform 在 macOS 沙箱里穿过 MITM 代理做 TLS 校验。
keys.descEn: Let gh, gcloud, and terraform verify TLS behind a MITM proxy inside the sandbox on macOS
keys.meaningEn: Let sandboxed commands on macOS reach the system TLS trust service, `com.apple.trustd.agent`. Go-based tools such as `gh`, `gcloud`, and `terraform` need it to verify TLS certificates when you use `network.httpProxyPort` with a MITM proxy and a custom CA. This reduces security by opening a potential data exfiltration path through the trust service.
typeValues: `true`: sandboxed commands on macOS can reach `com.apple.trustd.agent`
`false`: sandboxed commands on macOS can't reach the system TLS trust service

keys.zhMeaning: 列出始终在沙箱外运行的命令。
keys.descEn: Name commands that always run outside the sandbox
keys.meaningEn: Name commands that Claude Code always runs outside the sandbox, such as tools that don't work under it. Each entry uses the same syntax as the content of a `Bash(...)` permission rule: an exact command, a prefix such as `docker *`, or a wildcard pattern. When any part of a compound command matches an entry, Claude Code runs the whole command unsandboxed.
keys.default: unset, so every command Claude Code can sandbox runs sandboxed

keys.zhMeaning: 沙箱无法启动时拒绝启动，而不是退回非沙箱。
keys.descEn: Refuse to start when the sandbox can't, instead of running unsandboxed
keys.meaningEn: Make Claude Code exit with an error at startup when `sandbox.enabled` is `true` but the sandbox can't start, because a dependency is missing or the platform is unsupported. Without it, Claude Code shows a warning and runs commands unsandboxed. Use it in managed settings when your organization requires sandboxing as a hard gate.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code exits with an error at startup when `sandbox.enabled` is `true` but the sandbox can't start
`false`: Claude Code shows a warning and runs commands unsandboxed

keys.zhMeaning: 控制沙箱命令可读写的路径。
keys.descEn: Control which paths sandboxed commands can read and write
keys.meaningEn: Control which paths sandboxed commands can read and write. By default they can write to the working directory, any directories you add with `--add-dir`, and the session temp directory, and can read the rest of the filesystem, including credential files. Widen or narrow that with the four path lists, or switch the filesystem layer off with `disabled`. See Filesystem isolation for the default boundaries.
keys.type: object with `allowWrite`, `denyWrite`, `denyRead`, and `allowRead` arrays, plus the `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` and `disabled` Booleans
keys.default: unset, so the default read and write boundaries apply

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止开发者重新打开组织已拦截的读路径。
keys.descEn: Stop developers from re-opening read paths your organization blocked
keys.meaningEn: Honor only the `allowRead` entries that come from managed settings, so developers can't re-open read access to paths your organization blocked. `denyRead` entries still merge from every settings file.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code honors only the `allowRead` entries from managed settings
`false`: `allowRead` entries merge from every settings file

keys.zhMeaning: 在 denyRead 拦截的区域内重新打开读取。
keys.descEn: Re-open reading inside a region denyRead blocks
keys.meaningEn: Re-open reading for specific paths inside a region that `denyRead` blocks, to build workspace-only read access. An exact or wildcard `denyRead` entry stays blocked inside a broader `allowRead`, as the overlap table shows. When a wildcard `denyRead` entry such as `~/**/.env` matches a directory, Claude Code blocks reads of its contents as well. Before v2.1.236 on macOS, Claude Code re-opened the paths a wildcard `denyRead` entry matched wherever a broader `allowRead` entry covered them, and left a matched directory's contents readable.
keys.type: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

keys.zhMeaning: 增加沙箱命令可以写入的路径。
keys.descEn: Add paths sandboxed commands can write to
keys.meaningEn: Add paths where sandboxed commands can write, beyond the working directory and the session temp directory. Use it when a subprocess such as `kubectl` or a build tool needs to write outside the project.
keys.type: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes
keys.default: unset, so sandboxed commands can write only to the working directory and the session temp directory

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止沙箱命令读取指定路径。
keys.descEn: Block sandboxed commands from reading specific paths
keys.meaningEn: Block sandboxed commands from reading specific paths, such as credential files that the default read policy would otherwise expose. To protect a credential file and keep it usable through the sandbox proxy, see `sandbox.credentials` instead.
keys.type: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes
keys.default: unset, so sandboxed commands keep the default read access, which includes credential files such as `~/.aws/credentials`

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止沙箱命令写入指定路径。
keys.descEn: Block sandboxed commands from writing to specific paths
keys.meaningEn: Block sandboxed commands from writing to specific paths, including paths inside a directory that is otherwise writable.
keys.type: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

keys.zhMeaning: 关闭文件系统隔离，但保留网络隔离。
keys.descEn: Turn off filesystem isolation while keeping network isolation
keys.meaningEn: Skip filesystem isolation while keeping network isolation. Sandboxed commands get unrestricted read and write access to the host filesystem, and their network egress stays confined to `network.allowedDomains`. Use it when you sandbox to control where commands connect rather than what they write. Requires Claude Code v2.1.216 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code skips filesystem isolation and keeps network isolation
`false`: filesystem isolation stays on
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. When managed settings configure `sandbox.filesystem` at all, or list a `sandbox.credentials.files` entry with `"mode": "deny"`, only managed settings can set it.

keys.zhMeaning: 对命令预期会探测的路径静默违规报告。
keys.descEn: Silence violation reports for paths a command is expected to probe
keys.meaningEn: Silence sandbox violation reports for paths you expect a command to probe and be refused, such as a tool that checks `/etc/hosts` on startup, so those denials don't show up as violations or in what Claude sees. The sandbox still blocks the access; only the report is suppressed. Keys are substrings to match against the command, with `*` matching every command, and values are substrings of the violation to ignore for that command, such as a filesystem path.
keys.type: object mapping a command substring to an array of violation substrings, usually paths
keys.default: unset, so every violation is reported

keys.zhMeaning: 控制沙箱命令可到达的主机、端口和套接字。
keys.descEn: Control which hosts, ports, and sockets sandboxed commands reach
keys.meaningEn: Control which hosts, ports, and sockets sandboxed commands can reach. The sandbox routes outbound traffic through a proxy that enforces these lists; see Network isolation for how the proxy decides and when it prompts.
keys.default: unset, so no domains are pre-allowed and the sandbox prompts for each new host
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. `strictAllowlist`, `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and `tlsTerminate` are read from fewer sources, as their entries say.

keys.zhName: 允许全部 Unix 套接字
keys.zhMeaning: 允许沙箱命令连接每一个 Unix socket。
keys.descEn: Let sandboxed commands connect to every Unix socket
keys.meaningEn: Let sandboxed commands connect to every Unix socket. On Linux and WSL2, the sandbox's seccomp filter blocks `socket(AF_UNIX, ...)` calls, so this is the only way to permit Unix sockets there. When the filter is missing, which `/sandbox` reports on its Dependencies tab, the sandbox doesn't block Unix-socket calls. See Set up Linux and WSL2 for where the filter comes from.
typeValues: `true`: sandboxed commands can connect to every Unix socket
`false`: the sandbox blocks Unix-socket connections: on macOS except the paths in `allowUnixSockets`, and on Linux and WSL2 through the seccomp filter when it's present

keys.zhMeaning: 预放行域名，避免沙箱命令逐个提示。
keys.descEn: Pre-allow domains so sandboxed commands don't prompt for them
keys.meaningEn: Pre-allow domains for outbound traffic from sandboxed commands, so the sandbox doesn't prompt for them. Wildcards such as `*.example.com` match subdomains, and an optional `:port` suffix limits an entry to one port; an entry without a port matches every port.
keys.type: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional `:port` suffix
keys.default: unset, so the sandbox prompts the first time a command reaches a new host
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Only managed settings when `allowManagedDomainsOnly` is set.

keys.zhMeaning: 允许沙箱命令在 macOS 上绑定 localhost 端口。
keys.descEn: Let sandboxed commands bind to localhost ports on macOS
keys.meaningEn: Let sandboxed commands bind to localhost ports on macOS, for example to start a dev server.
typeValues: `true`: sandboxed commands can bind to localhost ports on macOS
`false`: sandboxed commands on macOS can't bind to localhost ports

keys.zhMeaning: 让 iOS Simulator 或 Playwright 等 macOS 沙箱工具到达其 XPC 服务。
keys.descEn: Let macOS sandboxed tools like the iOS Simulator or Playwright reach their XPC services
keys.meaningEn: List additional XPC and Mach service names the macOS sandbox may look up. Tools that communicate over XPC, such as the iOS Simulator or Playwright, need their services listed here.
keys.type: array of strings, each a service name; a single trailing `*` matches a prefix, and `"*"` alone matches every service

keys.zhMeaning: 把网络允许列表锁定为托管设置。
keys.descEn: Lock the network allowlist to managed settings
keys.meaningEn: Lock the network allowlist to what managed settings define. Claude Code then honors only `allowedDomains` and `WebFetch(domain:...)` allow rules from managed settings, ignores domains from user, project, local, and `--settings` settings, and blocks a non-allowed domain automatically instead of prompting.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code honors only `allowedDomains` and `WebFetch(domain:...)` allow rules from managed settings and blocks a non-allowed domain instead of prompting
`false`: domains from user, project, local, and `--settings` settings merge into the allowlist

keys.zhName: 允许的 Unix 套接字
keys.zhMeaning: 列出沙箱命令在 macOS 上可用的 Unix socket 路径。
keys.descEn: List Unix socket paths sandboxed commands can use on macOS
keys.meaningEn: List the Unix socket paths sandboxed commands can connect to on macOS. Claude Code ignores this list on Linux and WSL2, where the seccomp filter can't inspect socket paths; use `allowAllUnixSockets` there instead.
keys.type: array of strings, each a socket path
keys.default: unset, so the macOS sandbox blocks every Unix socket

keys.zhMeaning: 即使落在允许的通配符内，也屏蔽这些域名。
keys.descEn: Block domains for sandboxed commands, even inside an allowed wildcard
keys.meaningEn: Block domains for outbound traffic from sandboxed commands, using the same wildcard, port, and IPv6 syntax as `allowedDomains`. A denied domain stays blocked even when an `allowedDomains` entry matches it too.
keys.type: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional `:port` suffix

keys.zhMeaning: 把沙箱 HTTP 流量转到你自己的代理；值为本地 TCP 端口号。
keys.descEn: Route sandbox HTTP traffic through your own proxy
keys.meaningEn: Point the sandbox at your own HTTP proxy instead of the one Claude Code runs. Organizations do this to inspect HTTPS traffic, apply their own filtering rules, or log every request. When unset, Claude Code starts its own proxy for HTTP traffic.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy
keys.numeric: 官方：本地 TCP 端口号。默认未设置，由 Claude Code 自己跑 HTTP 代理。

keys.zhMeaning: 把沙箱 SOCKS 流量转到你自己的代理；值为本地 TCP 端口号。
keys.descEn: Route sandbox SOCKS traffic through your own proxy
keys.meaningEn: Point the sandbox at your own SOCKS5 proxy instead of the one Claude Code runs. When unset, Claude Code starts its own proxy for SOCKS traffic.
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy
keys.numeric: 官方：本地 TCP 端口号。默认未设置，由 Claude Code 自己跑 SOCKS 代理。

keys.zhMeaning: 对允许列表外的主机直接拒绝，而不是提示。
keys.descEn: Deny hosts outside the allowlist instead of prompting
keys.meaningEn: Deny sandboxed commands access to hosts outside the allowlist instead of prompting for approval. The allowlist is `allowedDomains` plus domains from `WebFetch(domain:...)` allow rules, or only the managed settings entries when `allowManagedDomainsOnly` is set. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code denies sandboxed commands access to hosts outside the allowlist

`false`: unless another trusted settings file sets `true`, Claude Code decides a host outside the allowlist by permission mode instead of denying it outright: it runs the classifier in auto mode, denies in `dontAsk` mode, allows in `bypassPermissions` mode and in plan mode when bypass is available, and otherwise asks you
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. A repository can't turn it on or off.

keys.zhMeaning: 让沙箱代理终止 TLS，以便读取 HTTPS 请求内容。
keys.descEn: Have the sandbox proxy terminate TLS so it can read HTTPS requests
keys.meaningEn: Make the sandbox proxy terminate TLS so it can read the contents of HTTPS requests. This is experimental, and `mask` credential substitution requires it. Set `{}` to generate an ephemeral certificate authority for the session, or set `caCertPath` and `caKeyPath` to use your own.
keys.type: object with optional `caCertPath` and `caKeyPath` strings, each a file path
keys.default: unset, so the proxy doesn't terminate or inspect TLS
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. A repository can't switch it on or supply a certificate authority.

keys.zhMeaning: 在沙箱内使用你自己的 ripgrep 二进制。
keys.descEn: Use your own ripgrep binary inside the sandbox
keys.meaningEn: Point the sandbox at a ripgrep binary of your own instead of the one Claude Code uses, for example when your platform needs a differently built `rg`.
keys.type: object with `command`, the path to the ripgrep binary, and optional `args`, an array of arguments to prepend
keys.default: unset, so the sandbox uses the same ripgrep binary as Claude Code. That is the bundled binary unless you set `USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP` to `0`

keys.zhMeaning: 指向 PATH 之外的 socat 二进制，供沙箱代理使用。
keys.descEn: Point the sandbox proxy at a socat binary outside PATH
keys.meaningEn: Point the sandbox network proxy at a `socat` binary installed outside `PATH`.
keys.type: string, an absolute path; Claude Code drops a relative path and falls back to `PATH` lookup
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code finds `socat` on `PATH`

keys.zhName: 接受计划时清空上下文
keys.zhMeaning: 在计划接受屏幕上显示“清空上下文”选项。
keys.descEn: Show a "clear context" option on the plan accept screen
keys.meaningEn: When Claude finishes a plan in plan mode, it shows an approval menu. Planning can use a lot of context, so this key adds a first option to that menu, **Yes, clear context and …**, that approves the plan, clears the conversation context, and starts implementing from the plan alone. The rest of the label names the permission mode the session continues in, and shows how much of your context the planning used.
typeValues: `true`: the plan approval menu gets a first option, **Yes, clear context and …**, that approves the plan and clears the conversation context
`false`: the plan approval menu shows no clear-context option

keys.zhMeaning: 展开思考时看到摘要，而不是折叠占位。
keys.descEn: See summaries of Claude's thinking instead of a collapsed stub
keys.meaningEn: See summaries of Claude's extended thinking in interactive sessions. Set it if you want the full summaries when you expand thinking with `Ctrl+O`. When unset or `false`, the Anthropic API redacts thinking blocks and Claude Code shows a collapsed stub; third-party providers don't redact.
typeValues: `true`: you see full thinking summaries when you expand thinking with `Ctrl+O`
`false`: the Anthropic API redacts thinking blocks and Claude Code shows a collapsed stub

keys.zhMeaning: 显示或隐藏每条回复后的 Cooked for 时长。
keys.descEn: Hide the "Cooked for" duration after each response
keys.meaningEn: Show or hide the turn duration message after each response, such as "Cooked for 1m 6s". Appears in `/config` as **Show turn duration**.
typeValues: `true`: you see the turn duration message after each response
`false`: Claude Code hides the turn duration message
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A value in `~/.claude.json` from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.

keys.zhMeaning: 为技能列表预留的上下文窗口比例；这是分数，不是整数百分比。
keys.descEn: Reserve more or less context for the skill listing
keys.meaningEn: Each turn, Claude sees a listing of your skills with their descriptions, and Claude Code caps that listing at a share of the context window. When the listing is over the cap, Claude Code keeps every skill's name but drops the descriptions of the least-used skills, so Claude can still invoke those skills but is less likely to choose one on its own. Raise this key to keep more descriptions visible at the cost of more context per turn.
keys.type: number, a fraction greater than `0` and at most `1`
keys.default: `0.01`, which reserves 1% of the context window
keys.numeric: 官方：大于 0 且至多 1 的分数。默认 0.01，即预留上下文窗口的 1%。

keys.zhMeaning: 技能列表里每条描述的字符上限。
keys.descEn: Cap each skill's description length in the skill listing
keys.meaningEn: Each turn, Claude sees a listing of your skills that shows each skill's `description` and `when_to_use` text. This key caps how many characters of that text Claude Code shows per skill; longer text is cut at the cap.
keys.type: number of characters, a positive integer
keys.numeric: 官方：正整数，单位是字符。默认 1536。

keys.zhMeaning: 不改 SKILL.md 即可隐藏或折叠某个 skill。
keys.descEn: Hide or collapse a skill without editing its SKILL.md
keys.meaningEn: Hide or collapse a skill without editing its `SKILL.md`. Claude Code applies the value under each skill's name to the skill list Claude sees and to your `/` autocomplete.
keys.type: object mapping skill name to one of:
typeValues: `"on"`: Claude sees the skill and you can type `/name`
`"name-only"`: Claude sees the skill by name without its description
`"user-invocable-only"`: Claude doesn't see the skill, but you can still type `/name`
`"off"`: Claude doesn't see the skill and `/name` is hidden from autocomplete

keys.zhMeaning: 跳过你首次自行进入 auto mode 时的一次性说明。
keys.descEn: Skip the one-time notice Claude Code shows when you first enter auto mode yourself rather than through the built-in default
keys.meaningEn: Skip the one-time notice describing auto mode that Claude Code shows when you first enter auto mode yourself, for example through your own settings or the mode selector, rather than when the built-in default starts a session in it. Claude Code shows that notice once and then records that it was shown, so this key only matters where the notice hasn't appeared yet.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code skips the notice
`false`: the same as unset; the notice appears once unless another of these files sets `true`
keys.default: unset, so the notice appears once
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. A repository can't set it for you.

keys.zhMeaning: 进入 bypassPermissions 模式前跳过确认对话框。
keys.descEn: Skip the confirmation dialog before bypassPermissions mode
keys.meaningEn: Skip the confirmation dialog Claude Code shows before a session enters `bypassPermissions` mode, whether from `--dangerously-skip-permissions` or from `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"`. Claude Code writes `true` here in your user settings when you accept that dialog once.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code skips the confirmation dialog before a session enters `bypassPermissions` mode
`false`: the same as unset; the dialog appears unless another of these files sets `true`
keys.scopeZh: 用户 / 本地 / 托管
keys.scopeDetail: `User, local, or managed`. An untrusted repository can't skip the dialog for you.

keys.zhMeaning: 在 Anthropic 不可达时跳过 WebFetch 主机名检查。
keys.descEn: Skip the WebFetch hostname check when Anthropic is unreachable
keys.meaningEn: Skip the WebFetch domain safety check, which sends each requested hostname to `api.anthropic.com` before fetching. Set `true` in environments that block traffic to Anthropic, such as Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry deployments with restrictive egress.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code skips the WebFetch domain safety check
`false`: the check runs before the first fetch to each hostname in a session, and again for a hostname whose earlier check was blocked or failed
keys.default: unset, so the check runs before the first fetch to each hostname in a session

keys.zhMeaning: 用你安装的拼写检查器在输入框标出拼写错误。
keys.descEn: Underline misspelled words in the prompt input with a spell checker you install
keys.meaningEn: Underline misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using a spell checker you install. Claude Code checks only the text in the input box. Check spelling as you type covers installing aspell, hunspell, or ispell and what the checker covers. Requires Claude Code v2.1.235 or later.
keys.type: object with `enabled` (Boolean), `checker` (`"aspell"`, `"hunspell"`, `"ispell"`, or `"auto"`), `language` (string, passed to the checker as its dictionary name), and `color` (string, a terminal color name, `#rrggbb`, `rgb(r,g,b)`, `ansi256(n)`, or `ansi:<name>`)
keys.default: unset, so spell checking is off; `checker` defaults to `"auto"`, the first of the three found on `PATH`; `language` defaults to the checker's own dictionary; `color` defaults to the theme's error color
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. The block from the highest tier that sets it applies as a whole.

keys.zhMeaning: Claude 工作时在转圈动画里显示或隐藏 tips。
keys.descEn: Hide tips in the spinner while Claude works
keys.meaningEn: While Claude works, the spinner line rotates through short tips about Claude Code features, such as "Use Plan Mode to prepare for a complex request before making changes. Press Shift+Tab twice to enable." Set this key to `false` to hide them. Appears in `/config` as **Show tips**.
typeValues: `true`: you see tips in the spinner while Claude is working
`false`: Claude Code hides spinner tips

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的字符串替换或扩展转圈 tips。
keys.descEn: Replace or extend spinner tips with your own strings
keys.meaningEn: Replace or extend the spinner tips, the short hints Claude Code rotates through while Claude works, with your own strings, such as a team reminder to run a review skill. Set `excludeDefault` to `true` and list at least one tip to show only your tips; when it's `false` or absent, or `tips` is empty, Claude Code keeps the built-in tips and adds yours.
keys.type: object with a `tips` array of strings and an optional `excludeDefault` Boolean
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code shows only the built-in tips

keys.zhMeaning: 增加或替换回合进行时显示的动词。
keys.descEn: Add or replace the verbs shown while a turn runs
keys.meaningEn: While a turn is in progress, the spinner shows a rotating verb such as "Accomplishing", "Architecting", or "Baking". Use this key to add your own verbs to that rotation or replace the built-in list with yours.
keys.type: object with a `verbs` array of strings and `mode`, one of:
typeValues: `"append"`: Claude Code adds your verbs to the built-in set
`"replace"`: Claude Code shows only your verbs
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in verbs

keys.zhMeaning: 把 SSH 连接加入 Desktop 环境下拉列表。
keys.descEn: Add SSH connections to the Desktop environment dropdown
keys.meaningEn: Add SSH connections to the Desktop environment dropdown. Administrators use it to distribute shared connections to a team. Connections you define in managed settings show as managed, so users can select them but can't edit or delete them in the app.
keys.type: array of objects, each with required `id`, `name`, and `sshHost` and optional `sshPort` and `sshIdentityFile`
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. The desktop app reads this key.

keys.zhMeaning: 限制 Desktop SSH 会话可以连接的主机。
keys.descEn: Limit which hosts Desktop SSH sessions can reach
keys.meaningEn: Limit the hosts a Desktop SSH session can connect to. Only the Desktop app reads this key; the CLI doesn't. Patterns are case-insensitive: `*` matches any host, `*.example.com` matches `example.com` and every subdomain, and anything else is an exact match against the hostname after `~/.ssh/config` resolution. An empty array turns SSH sessions off.
keys.default: unset, so any host is allowed

keys.zhMeaning: 运行你自己的命令，在提示下方渲染状态栏。
keys.descEn: Run your own command to render a status line below the prompt
keys.meaningEn: Run your own command to render a status line below the prompt with context such as the model, cost, or git branch. Optional fields adjust spacing, add periodic re-runs, and hide the built-in vim mode indicator when your script renders `vim.mode` itself.
keys.type: object with `type` set to `"command"` and a `command` string, plus optional `padding` as a number of characters, `refreshInterval` as a number of seconds, minimum `1`, and `hideVimModeIndicator` as a Boolean
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. When `allowManagedHooksOnly` is on, or `disableAllHooks` is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.
keys.numeric: 官方类型说明：object with `type` set to `"command"` and a `command` string, plus optional `padding` as a number of characters, `refreshInterval` as a number of seconds, minimum `1`, and `hideVimModeIndicator` as a Boolean

keys.zhMeaning: 只允许用户添加和安装名单中的市场来源。
keys.descEn: Allowlist the marketplace sources users can add and install from
keys.meaningEn: Restrict which plugin marketplace sources people in your organization can add and install plugins from. Claude Code enforces the allowlist on marketplace add and on plugin install, update, refresh, and auto-update, before any network or filesystem operation, so a marketplace someone added before you set the policy can't be used to fetch plugins once its source no longer matches. Blocked users see an error naming the managed policy.
keys.type: array of marketplace source objects; see Allowed source types
keys.default: unset, so users can add any marketplace. An empty array is a complete lockdown that blocks every marketplace source, including the official Anthropic marketplace

keys.zhMeaning: 阻止来自用户和项目来源的 skills、agents、hooks 和 MCP 服务器。
keys.descEn: Block skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from user and project sources
keys.meaningEn: Block skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from user and project sources, so they can come only from plugins or managed settings. Combine it with `strictKnownMarketplaces` to control the full customization supply chain: the marketplace allowlist controls which plugins users can install.
keys.type: `true` to lock all four kinds of customization, or an array naming the kinds to lock, from `"skills"`, `"agents"`, `"hooks"`, and `"mcp"`

keys.zhMeaning: 把 agents 锁定为插件和托管来源。
keys.descEn: Lock agents to plugin and managed sources
keys.meaningEn: Lock the `agents` surface. Claude Code stops loading agents from `~/.claude/agents/` and `.claude/agents/`, and keeps loading plugin agents, built-in agents, and agents in the managed policy directory.

keys.zhMeaning: 把 hooks 锁定为插件和托管来源。
keys.descEn: Lock hooks to plugin and managed sources
keys.meaningEn: Lock the `hooks` surface. Claude Code stops running hooks from user, project, and local `settings.json`, and keeps running plugin hooks and hooks in managed settings.

keys.zhMeaning: 把 MCP 服务器锁定为插件和托管来源。
keys.descEn: Lock MCP servers to plugin and managed sources
keys.meaningEn: Lock the `mcp` surface. Claude Code stops loading MCP servers from `~/.claude.json` and `.mcp.json`, and keeps loading plugin MCP servers and `managed-mcp.json` servers.

keys.zhMeaning: 把 skills 锁定为插件和托管来源。
keys.descEn: Lock skills to plugin and managed sources
keys.meaningEn: Lock the `skills` surface. Claude Code stops loading skills from `~/.claude/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`, custom commands from `~/.claude/commands/` and `.claude/commands/`, skills under `--add-dir` directories, and skills synced from your claude.ai account, and keeps loading plugin skills, bundled skills, and skills in the managed policy directory.

keys.zhMeaning: 选择子代理及其他主对话外请求的 prompt cache 寿命；取值是 "5m" 或 "1h"。
keys.descEn: Choose the prompt cache lifetime for subagents and other requests outside the main conversation
keys.meaningEn: Choose how long the prompt cache holds the requests Claude Code makes outside the main conversation. This key applies to subagents, workflows, and Claude Code's own background and helper requests, such as compaction and session titles. The one-hour lifetime keeps the cache warm across longer breaks, and the API bills each cache write at a higher rate than at the five-minute lifetime. Requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.
typeValues: `"5m"`: the cache holds for five minutes
`"1h"`: the cache holds for an hour
keys.default: unset, so each of these requests gets its default lifetime
keys.overrides: `FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M` takes precedence over everything else, then `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL`, then this key, and last `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`, which asks for the one-hour lifetime on every request
keys.numeric: 官方取值是字符串 "5m" 或 "1h"，不是原始数字。默认未设置，沿用各请求自己的默认寿命。

keys.zhMeaning: 用你自己的命令改写子代理任务显示行。
keys.descEn: Rewrite rows in the subagent task display with your own command
keys.meaningEn: When Claude runs subagents, Claude Code lists them in a task display below the prompt, one row per subagent showing `name · description · token count`. This key lets you run your own command to rewrite those rows, for example to show each subagent's context usage as a percentage. On each refresh, Claude Code sends the visible rows as one JSON object on stdin, with a `tasks` array carrying each subagent's `id`, `name`, `status`, `model`, `tokenCount`, and more, and replaces the row for each `id` you write back as a `{"id", "content"}` line. Rows you don't write back keep the default rendering.
keys.type: object with `type` set to `"command"` and a `command` string
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code renders the default rows
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. When `allowManagedHooksOnly` is on, or `disableAllHooks` is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.

keys.zhMeaning: 安全分类器标记请求时自动切换，或暂停让你选择。
keys.descEn: Switch models automatically or pause when a safety classifier flags a request
keys.meaningEn: Choose what happens when a safety classifier flags a request: switch to the fallback model and continue, or pause so you can choose between switching and editing the prompt.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code switches to the fallback model and continues
`false`: in an interactive session Claude Code pauses so you can choose between switching and editing the prompt; where no dialog can show, such as a `-p` run, the flagged request ends as an error
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Appears in `/config` as **Switch models when a message is flagged**.

keys.zhMeaning: 停止下载你在 claude.ai 账户上启用的 skills，并隐藏已同步的技能。
keys.descEn: Stop downloading the skills enabled on your claude.ai account and hide the ones already synced
keys.meaningEn: Turn off the download of the skills you enable on claude.ai. Claude Code downloads them into `~/.claude/skills/synced/` when you run it in non-interactive mode with the `-p` flag and `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` set. Set `false` to stop that download and hide the skills it already synced. Claude Code honors only `false`: `true` is the same as unset and doesn't turn syncing on.
typeValues: `false`: Claude Code stops downloading synced skills and hides the ones already in `~/.claude/skills/synced/`. In user or managed settings, it also moves them to `~/.claude/skills/.trash/`
`true`: the same as unset
keys.default: unset, so a non-interactive run with `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` set downloads the skills
keys.scopeZh: 用户 / 本地 / 托管
keys.scopeDetail: `User, local, or managed`. A repository can't turn it off for you.

keys.zhMeaning: 关闭 diff 和代码块中的语法高亮。
keys.descEn: Turn off syntax highlighting in diffs and code blocks
keys.meaningEn: Claude Code colors code by language in the diffs, code blocks, and file previews it shows in the terminal, with its built-in highlighter; no plugin or language server is involved. Set this key to `true` to show them as plain text instead, for example if the colors clash with your terminal theme or slow a screen reader.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code turns off syntax highlighting in diffs, code blocks, and file previews
`false`: Claude Code highlights syntax

keys.zhMeaning: 已在 v2.1.234 移除；当前版本设置它没有效果，队友跟随主会话模型。
keys.descEn: Removed in v2.1.234; teammates follow the lead's model
keys.meaningEn: Removed in v2.1.234, together with its `/config` row **Default teammate model**. Setting it has no effect on current versions.
keys.type: string, a model alias or full model ID, or `null`

keys.zhMeaning: 选择 agent team 队友的显示方式。
keys.descEn: Choose how agent team teammates display
keys.meaningEn: Choose where Claude Code shows agent team teammates: inside your main terminal pane, or in split panes when your terminal supports them. See Choose a display mode.
typeValues: `"in-process"`: teammates run inside your main terminal pane
`"auto"`: split panes when you're running inside tmux, or inside iTerm2 with `it2` on your `PATH` or tmux installed; in-process otherwise
`"tmux"`: split panes using tmux or iTerm2, detected from your terminal
`"iterm2"`: iTerm2 native split panes through the `it2` CLI, in Claude Code v2.1.186 or later
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Claude Code also reads a value left in `~/.claude.json` by older versions.
keys.overrides: `--teammate-mode` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 在支持的终端里显示或隐藏进度条。
keys.descEn: Hide the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it
keys.meaningEn: Some terminals can show a progress indicator on the tab or in the taskbar for the program running in them. While Claude is working, Claude Code reports an in-progress state to the terminal and clears it when the turn ends, so you can see from another tab or window whether Claude is still busy. It does so only in terminals that support the indicator: ConEmu, Ghostty 1.2.0 or later, and iTerm2 3.6.6 or later. Set this key to `false` to stop reporting it. Appears in `/config` as **Terminal progress bar**.
typeValues: `true`: you see the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it
`false`: Claude Code hides the terminal progress bar
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A value in `~/.claude.json` from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.

keys.zhMeaning: 允许或阻止 /rename 与 --name 更改终端标签标题。
keys.descEn: Stop /rename and --name from changing the terminal tab title
keys.meaningEn: Claude Code sets your terminal tab's title. By default it uses a title it generates from the conversation, and once you give the session a name with `/rename` or `--name`, the tab shows that name instead. Set this key to `false` to keep the generated title on the tab even after you name the session. The name itself still applies, so `/resume <name>` and the session picker find it.
typeValues: `true`: the terminal tab title shows the session name you set
`false`: the tab keeps the title Claude Code generates from your conversation

keys.zhMeaning: 选择界面颜色主题，内置或自定义。
keys.descEn: Pick the interface color theme, built-in or custom
keys.meaningEn: Pick the color theme for the interface. Appears in `/config` as **Theme**.
typeValues: `"auto"`: matches your terminal's light or dark background
`"dark"`: the dark theme
`"light"`: the light theme
`"dark-daltonized"`: the dark theme with colorblind-friendly colors
`"light-daltonized"`: the light theme with colorblind-friendly colors
`"dark-ansi"`: the dark theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette
`"light-ansi"`: the light theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette
`"custom:<slug>"` or `"custom:<plugin-name>:<slug>"`: a custom theme from `~/.claude/themes/` or a plugin
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A value in `~/.claude.json` from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.

keys.zhMeaning: 选择全屏或经典终端渲染器。
keys.descEn: Choose the fullscreen or classic terminal renderer
keys.meaningEn: Choose the terminal UI renderer. Use `"fullscreen"` for the flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback, or `"default"` for the classic main-screen renderer. Running `/tui fullscreen` or `/tui default` writes this key for you.
typeValues: `"default"`: the classic main-screen renderer
`"fullscreen"`: the flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code picks the renderer for you
keys.overrides: `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN` take precedence over this key for one session: `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1` turns fullscreen on, and `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=0` or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1` turns it off; when both are set, Claude Code turns it off

keys.zhMeaning: 让 Claude 在每个实质性任务上自动规划 workflow，无需被点名。
keys.descEn: Have Claude plan a workflow for each substantive task without being asked
keys.meaningEn: Start sessions with ultracode on. With it on, Claude plans a workflow for each substantive task instead of waiting for you to ask. Claude plans workflows only when dynamic workflows are enabled for you and your model supports `xhigh` effort. Either way, `ultracode: true` runs the session at `xhigh` effort. Claude Code reads this key but never writes it: `/effort ultracode` turns ultracode on for the current session only.
typeValues: `true`: sessions start at `xhigh` effort, with ultracode on when dynamic workflows are enabled for you and your model supports `xhigh`
`false`: sessions start with ultracode off
keys.overrides: `/effort ultracode` turns ultracode on for one session without this key. So does `--effort ultracode`, which requires Claude Code v2.1.203 or later

keys.zhName: 计划模式使用自动模式
keys.zhMeaning: 让 auto mode 分类器在 plan mode 中审查 shell 命令。
keys.descEn: Let the auto mode classifier review shell commands in plan mode; set false to get prompts instead
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether Claude Code uses the auto mode classifier to review shell commands in plan mode. With the default `true`, the classifier reviews each command during planning when auto mode is available and you see no prompt. Set `false` to get a permission prompt for every command outside the built-in read-only set. Appears in `/config` as **Use auto mode during plan**.
typeValues: `true`: the same as unset; when auto mode is available, the classifier reviews each shell command during planning instead of prompting you for it. A `false` in any of these files still turns it off
`false`: you get a permission prompt for every command outside the built-in read-only set
keys.scopeZh: 用户 / 本地 / 托管
keys.scopeDetail: `User, local, or managed`. A repository can't turn it off for you.

keys.zhMeaning: 显示完整工具输出而不是截断摘要；与 viewMode 同时设置时 viewMode 优先。
keys.descEn: Show full tool output instead of truncated summaries; viewMode takes precedence when both are set
keys.meaningEn: By default, the transcript collapses each tool call to a short summary, such as the command Claude ran and a line count of its output, and you press `Ctrl+O` to switch the whole transcript to the expanded view when you want the details. Set this key to `true` to show every tool call's full input and output inline as it happens, which is useful when you're debugging a hook, an MCP server, or a long shell command. Appears in `/config` as **Verbose output**.
typeValues: `true`: you see full tool output
`false`: you see truncated summaries of tool output
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A value in `~/.claude.json` from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.
keys.overrides: `--verbose` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 让每个会话以 default、verbose 或 focus 视图启动。
keys.descEn: Start every session in default, verbose, or focus view
keys.meaningEn: Set the transcript view Claude Code starts in: `"default"`, `"verbose"`, or `"focus"`. When set, it overrides both the sticky `/focus` selection and the `verbose` setting.
typeValues: `"default"`: the normal transcript with truncated tool output
`"verbose"`: the transcript with full tool output
`"focus"`: only your last prompt, a one-line summary of tool calls with edit diffstats, and the final response. Focus view needs the fullscreen renderer
keys.default: unset, so the `verbose` setting and your last `/focus` choice apply
keys.overrides: `--verbose` takes precedence over this key for one session

keys.zhMeaning: 把 jj 这类双键 INSERT 序列映射为 Escape。
keys.descEn: Map a two-key INSERT-mode sequence such as jj to Escape
keys.meaningEn: Map two-key INSERT-mode sequences to Escape in vim editor mode. Each key is exactly two printable characters typed in sequence, and `"<Esc>"` is the only supported target; Claude Code ignores other entries. Requires Claude Code v2.1.208 or later.
keys.type: object mapping a two-character sequence to `"<Esc>"`
keys.scopeDetail: `User or managed`. A repository can't remap your keystrokes.

keys.zhMeaning: 打开语音听写并选择按住或轻点模式。
keys.descEn: Turn on voice dictation and pick hold or tap mode
keys.meaningEn: Turn on voice dictation and choose how the dictation key behaves. Claude Code writes this object for you when you run `/voice`.
keys.type: object with `enabled` as a Boolean, `autoSubmit` as a Boolean that applies in hold mode only, and `mode`, one of:
typeValues: `"hold"`: you hold the dictation key while speaking and release it to stop
`"tap"`: you tap the key once to start recording and again to send
keys.default: unset, so dictation is off; when `enabled` is `true` and `mode` is unset, Claude Code uses `"hold"`

keys.zhMeaning: 用较旧的单键形式打开语音听写。
keys.descEn: Turn on voice dictation with the older single-key form
keys.meaningEn: Deprecated since v2.1.92, when the `voice` object replaced it. Claude Code still reads it so older settings files keep working, but new configurations should set `voice.enabled`.
typeValues: `true`: voice dictation is on when you're logged in with a claude.ai account and your organization's policy allows voice, unless `voice.enabled` is set
`false`: voice dictation is off, unless `voice.enabled` is set

keys.zhMeaning: 打开或关闭全屏渲染中的鼠标滚轮加速。
keys.descEn: Turn off mouse-wheel acceleration in fullscreen rendering
keys.meaningEn: Accelerate mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls in fullscreen rendering. Set it to `false` for a constant scroll rate per wheel notch. Requires Claude Code v2.1.174 or later.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code accelerates mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls
`false`: Claude Code scrolls at a constant rate per wheel notch

keys.zhMeaning: 让提示词里的 ultracode 启动 workflow；设为 false 可只输入该词而不启动。
keys.descEn: Let the word ultracode in a prompt start a workflow; set false to type it without starting one
keys.meaningEn: Choose whether typing the keyword `ultracode` in a prompt triggers a dynamic workflow. Set it to `false` to type the word without triggering one. Requires Claude Code v2.1.157 or later.
typeValues: `true`: typing `ultracode` in a prompt triggers a dynamic workflow
`false`: you can type the word without triggering one
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. Appears in `/config` as **Ultracode keyword trigger**.

keys.zhMeaning: 给动态 workflow 设定目标代理数量档位，不是强制上限。
keys.descEn: Set the agent count Claude aims for in dynamic workflows
keys.meaningEn: Set the agent count Claude aims for in the dynamic workflows it writes. Claude Code sends the value to Claude as advice, not an enforced cap: `"small"` asks for fewer than 5 agents, `"medium"` fewer than 15, and `"large"` fewer than 50. Choose `"small"` when you want to bound what a workflow spends. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later.
typeValues: `"unrestricted"`: no guideline, so Claude sizes the workflow to the task
`"small"`: Claude aims for fewer than 5 agents
`"medium"`: Claude aims for fewer than 15 agents
`"large"`: Claude aims for fewer than 50 agents
keys.scopeDetail: `Any file`. A value there takes precedence over the **Dynamic workflow size** choice in `/config`, which Claude Code stores in `~/.claude.json`, and Claude Code hides that row while a settings file sets the key.
keys.numeric: 官方是代理数量档位，不是原始数字："small" 少于 5 个代理，"medium" 少于 15，"large" 少于 50，"unrestricted" 无指引。默认 "medium"。这是给模型的建议，不是强制上限。

keys.zhMeaning: 配置 Claude Code 如何创建 git worktrees。
keys.descEn: Configure how Claude Code creates git worktrees
keys.meaningEn: Configure how Claude Code creates and manages git worktrees for `--worktree`, the `EnterWorktree` tool, and isolated subagents and background sessions.

keys.zhMeaning: 从远程默认分支或本地 HEAD 创建新 worktree。
keys.descEn: Branch new worktrees from the remote default branch or your local HEAD
keys.meaningEn: Choose which ref new worktrees branch from. `"fresh"` branches from `origin/<default-branch>` for a clean tree matching the remote; `"head"` branches from your current local `HEAD`, so unpushed commits and feature-branch state are present in the worktree.
typeValues: `"fresh"`: new worktrees branch from `origin/<default-branch>`
`"head"`: new worktrees branch from your current local `HEAD`, including unpushed commits

keys.zhMeaning: 允许后台会话在不创建 worktree 的情况下编辑工作副本。
keys.descEn: Let background sessions edit the working copy without a worktree
keys.meaningEn: Choose how background sessions isolate their file edits. With `"worktree"`, Claude Code blocks `Edit` and `Write` in the main checkout until the session calls `EnterWorktree`; with `"none"`, background jobs edit the working copy directly. Set `"none"` for a repository where git worktrees are impractical.
typeValues: `"worktree"`: Claude Code blocks `Edit` and `Write` in the main checkout until the session calls `EnterWorktree`
`"none"`: background jobs edit the working copy directly

keys.zhMeaning: 每个 worktree 只检出你需要的目录。
keys.descEn: Check out only the directories you need in each worktree
keys.meaningEn: Check out only the listed directories in each worktree through git sparse-checkout. Claude Code writes only those directories plus root-level files to disk, which is faster in large monorepos; see Check out only the directories you need.
keys.type: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root
keys.default: unset, so each worktree checks out the whole tree

keys.zhMeaning: 把大型目录符号链接进每个 worktree，而不是复制。
keys.descEn: Symlink large directories into each worktree instead of duplicating them
keys.meaningEn: Symlink directories from the main repository into each worktree so you don't duplicate large directories on disk.
keys.type: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root
keys.default: unset, so Claude Code symlinks no directories

keys.zhName: WSL 继承 Windows 设置
keys.zhMeaning: 让 WSL 上的 Claude Code 读取 Windows 策略链中的托管设置。
keys.descEn: Have WSL read managed settings from the Windows policy chain
keys.meaningEn: Have Claude Code on WSL read managed settings from the Windows policy chain, with HKLM and the Windows managed settings file taking priority over `/etc/claude-code` and HKCU below it. While the chain is on, Claude Code reads `/etc/claude-code` only when no managed settings file or drop-in under `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\` delivers a policy key other than `wslInheritsWindowsSettings` itself. Set it to extend the policy you already deploy on Windows to WSL sessions on the same machine, so they follow the same rules as host sessions. Claude Code honors it only when set in the HKLM registry key or in a managed settings file or drop-in under `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\`, both of which require Windows admin to write.
typeValues: `true`: Claude Code on WSL reads managed settings from the Windows policy chain, and reads `/etc/claude-code` only when no managed settings file or drop-in under `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\` delivers a policy key other than `wslInheritsWindowsSettings`
`false`: WSL reads only `/etc/claude-code`
